question: [गद्यांशः: वृक्षे चटका गजश्च] प्रमत्तः गजः किम् अकुर्वत्?
explanation: प्रमत्तः गजः शाखां शुण्डेन अत्रोटयत्।

version_note: Alternative language version of same Q.No. slot
question: मेघनादः कस्य नाम आसीत्?
explanation: मेघनादः मण्डूकस्य नाम आसीत्।

version_note: Alternative language version of same Q.No. slot
question: काष्ठकूटः चटकां कस्य समीपम् अनयत्?
explanation: काष्ठकूटः चटकां मक्षिकायाः समीपम् अनयत्।

version_note: Alternative language version of same Q.No. slot
question: 'अन्तिके' इत्यस्य शब्दस्य निम्नलिखितेषु कोऽर्थः?
explanation: 'अन्तिके' इत्यस्य अर्थः समीपम्।

version_note: Alternative language version of same Q.No. slot
question: 'मत्वा' शब्दस्य निर्वचनम् निम्नलिखितेषु किम् अस्ति?
explanation: 'मत्वा' = मन् + क्त्वा।

version_note: Alternative language version of same Q.No. slot
question: 'तृषार्तः' इत्यस्य शब्दस्य विग्रहं कृत्वा समासस्य नाम दीयताम्।
option_a: तृषया आर्तः य सः तृषार्तः - बहुव्रीहिः
explanation: तृषया आर्तः - तृतीया तत्पुरुष समासः।

version_note: Alternative language version of same Q.No. slot
question: 'यथोचितम्' अत्र सन्धिविच्छेदं कृत्वा सन्धेर्नाम निर्दिश्यताम्।
explanation: यथा + उचितम् = यथोचितम्, गुणसन्धिः।

version_note: Alternative language version of same Q.No. slot
question: [गद्यांशः: नर्मदातीरे वृक्षः] खगाः कुत्र अवसन्?
explanation: खगाः नीडेषु अवसन्।

version_note: Alternative language version of same Q.No. slot
question: वानरः कुत्र वसति स्म?
explanation: वानरः वृक्षतले वसति स्म।

version_note: Alternative language version of same Q.No. slot
question: एकदा किम् अभवत्?
explanation: एकदा महती वृष्टिः संजाता।

version_note: Alternative language version of same Q.No. slot
question: कीदृशं वानरं खगाः अवदन्?
explanation: शीतेन कम्पमानं वानरं खगाः अवदन्।

version_note: Alternative language version of same Q.No. slot
question: गद्यांशे प्रयुक्तस्य नीडशब्दस्य पर्यायवाची निम्नलिखितेषु कः शब्दः समीचीनः?
explanation: 'नीड' शब्दस्य पर्यायवाची 'कुलायः' अस्ति।

version_note: Alternative language version of same Q.No. slot
question: 'शाखामृगः' इत्यस्य अर्थे गद्यांशे कः शब्दः प्रयुक्तः?
explanation: 'शाखामृगः' अर्थे 'वानरः' शब्दः प्रयुक्तः।

version_note: Alternative language version of same Q.No. slot
question: 'कम्पमानम्' इत्यस्मिन् पदे कः कृत्प्रत्ययः प्रयुक्तः?
explanation: 'कम्पमानम्' पदे शानच् प्रत्ययः प्रयुक्तः।

version_note: Alternative language version of same Q.No. slot
question: 'अचिन्तयत्' क्रियापदम् इदम् कस्य गणस्य धातोः रूपम् अस्ति?
explanation: 'अचिन्तयत्' चुरादिगणस्य धातोः रूपम् अस्ति।

question: Which of these statements would advocates of progressive education agree with? / प्रगतिशील शिक्षा के हिमायती इनमें से किस कथन से सहमत होंगे?
option_a: Children are a distinct life-stage that hold importance because of 'what they would become as adults' rather than 'what they are as Children'.
option_b: Children are naturally 'good' and society corrupts them.
option_c: Children are naturally 'uncivilized' and socialization is necessary to make them moral human beings.
option_d: Children are born in a social, cultural, economic context and this background influences their development.
explanation: Progressive education: child shaped by social/cultural context.

question: Changes in emotion, self-perception and interpersonal relationships with families, peers and friends are studied under ______ domain of development.
explanation: Emotion and relationships fall under psycho-social domain.

question: The behaviours, interests, attitudes, skills and personality traits that a culture considers appropriate for specific gender are referred to as ______ and are ______.
explanation: Gender roles are culturally defined, not genetic.

question: Assertion (A): In an inclusive classroom, all curriculum adaptations should be directed to lower the educational standards for 'Special Children'. Reason (R): 'Special Children' do not have any potential for learning in mainstream classroom.
option_b: Both (A) and (R) are true and (R) is the correct explanation of (A)
option_c: Both (A) and (R) are true but (R) is not the correct explanation of (A)
explanation: Both statements about lowering standards are false.

question: As per Jan Piaget's theory of Cognitive Development:
option_a: Previous knowledge doesn't play any role in the process of learning.
option_b: Biological factors such as maturation don't play any role in cognitive development.
option_c: Learning experiences depend on children's current level of cognitive functioning.
option_d: Memorization should be prioritized over learning through experience.
explanation: Piaget: learning depends on current cognitive level.

question: Lev Vygotsky views cognitive development as:
option_a: effective adoption to the environment process
explanation: Vygotsky views cognitive development as collaborative.

question: While proposing the relationship between language and thinking process, Lev Vygotsky conceptualized language as a/an:
option_a: Independent domain which is not related to cognition.
option_b: Cultural tool which facilitates cognition in multiple ways.
option_c: form of egocentric speech used to only fulfill basic needs.
option_d: hindrance to the development of cognitive abilities.
explanation: Vygotsky: language is a cultural tool aiding cognition.

question: Which of the following is an example of a performance goal orientation?
option_a: A student studies hard to further her own growth.
option_b: A student studies hard to achieve a deep understanding of a topic.
option_c: A student studies hard to get a good grade and be better than others.
option_d: A student studies hard to learn as much as possible from the teacher.
explanation: Performance goal: studying to outperform others.

question: Following Lev Vygotsky's ideas, a teacher should:
option_a: practice reciprocal teaching with her students.
option_b: discourage the use of cultural tools by students.
option_c: disseminate the knowledge to be memorized by the students.
option_d: encourage students to compete with each other.
explanation: Vygotskian teacher practices reciprocal teaching.

question: Which of the following are effective strategies to teach new concepts? (i) Presenting examples (ii) Presenting non-examples (iii) Promoting thinking about relationships amongst concepts (iv) Giving a definition and encouraging students to rote memorize it.
explanation: Examples, non-examples and relational thinking teach concepts.

question: In which of the following method teacher and student interchange their roles?
explanation: Reciprocal teaching lets teacher and student swap roles.

question: Fiza analyzes that she has more problems in learning topic X than in learning topic Z because she is interested in topic Z and is paying focused attention to it. Which construct describes Fiza's abilities to analyze her thinking?
explanation: Analyzing one's own thinking is metacognition.

question: Howard Gardner's theory of multiple intelligence proposes that:
option_a: Intelligence can successfully predict academic success.
option_d: Intelligence can be measured accurately and predicated precisely.
explanation: Gardner: intelligences develop and change over time.

question: While there exists a possibility of intra-group individual differences, yet most students with Autism:
option_a: perform superior skills of imaginative play.
option_d: express strict adherence to routine or steps.
explanation: Autistic students often adhere strictly to routines.

question: Assertion (A): Creating an environment of fear and stress keeps students 'on their' toes and facilitates meaningful learning. Reason (R): Learning is governed only by extrinsic factors.
option_b: Both (A) and (R) are true and (R) is the correct explanation of (A)
option_c: Both (A) and (R) are true but (R) is not the correct explanation of (A)
explanation: Fear-based learning claim and extrinsic-only claim both false.

question: An example of 'class inclusion': Assertion (A): Lokesh has trouble with classifying one concept (Delhi) as a subset of another (India). Reason (R): Understanding how emotions affect memory and learning can lead to self-regulated learning.
option_b: Both (A) and (R) are true and (R) is the correct explanation of (A)
option_c: Both (A) and (R) are true but (R) is not the correct explanation of (A)
explanation: Class inclusion true; reason true but unrelated.

question: Which of the following statement aptly describes the purpose of a diagnostic assessment?
option_a: To identify the areas where students may need additional support or instruction.
option_b: To give students the opportunity to critically assess the work of their peers.
option_c: To identify the attitude patterns of students and design a career guidance programme.
option_d: To provide feedback to the teacher about their teaching methods.
explanation: Diagnostic assessment identifies areas needing support.

question: Ten year old Kakuli is struggling with a difficult math problem. What can her teacher do to enhance her problem-solving skills?
option_a: Give severe punishment so that it is not repeated in future.
option_b: Give her the solution to the problem.
option_c: Tell her to skip the problem and move on to the next one.
option_d: Encourage her to keep trying and offer scaffolding when needed.
explanation: Encourage persistence and offer scaffolding when needed.

question: Jean Piaget perceives ______ to be ______. Lev-Vygotsky believes ______ to be ______.
option_a: Private speech, effective in self-regulation; egocentric speech, a sign of cognitive immaturity
option_b: Egocentric speech, a sign of cognitive immaturity; private speech, effective in self-regulation
option_c: Egocentric speech, effective in self-regulation; private speech, a sign of cognitive immaturity
option_d: Private speech, a sign of cognitive immaturity; egocentric speech, effective in self-regulation
explanation: Piaget: egocentric immaturity; Vygotsky: private speech regulates.

question: Universal design for learning does NOT involve:
option_a: Practicing forms of labelling and categorization of learners.
option_b: Giving all learners various ways of acquiring information and knowledge.
option_c: Providing all learners alternatives for demonstrating what the learners know.
option_d: Tapping into all learners interests and offering challenges accordingly.
explanation: UDL excludes labelling and categorizing learners.

question: Which of the following statements about Lawrence Kohlberg's theory is correct?
option_a: It takes into account effects of culture and gender on moral reasoning.
option_b: It does not specify exact stages for progression of moral development in children.
option_c: It is based on the study done through experimental methods.
option_d: It presents conflicting situations to children.
explanation: Kohlberg presents moral dilemmas to children.

question: Assertion (A): Each child finds opportunities to play, experiment and discover their world. Reason (R): Childhood is a universal construct.
option_b: Both (A) and (R) are true and (R) is the correct explanation of (A)
option_c: Both (A) and (R) are true but (R) is not the correct explanation of (A)
explanation: Both childhood-opportunity and universality claims are false.

question: Which of the following is an example of a question that promotes analytical thinking?
option_a: Who was the leader of Germany during World War II?
option_b: In which year did World War II end?
option_c: Which countries were directly involved in the World War II?
option_d: Which factors contributed to the outbreak of World War II?
explanation: Asking about contributing factors promotes analytical thinking.

question: While engaging students who are visually challenged, teachers should use which ______. is ______ that ______.
option_a: Frequency modulated transmission devices; are an auditory system
option_d: Frequency modulated transmission devices; are a tactile system
explanation: Braille is a tactile system for visually challenged.

question: You are a teacher who wants to encourage your students to think critically and creatively. Which strategy is most likely to foster this type of thinking?
option_a: Lecturing on the topic and providing students with detailed notes.
option_b: Assigning a project in which students must memorize and present information.
option_c: Providing students with open-ended questions to come up with their own solutions.
option_d: Giving students multiple-choice tests to assess their knowledge.
explanation: Open-ended questions foster critical and creative thinking.

question: Which of the following is an example of assessment for student's learning?
option_a: A rubric given to students at the beginning of a project, outlining what they need to do.
option_b: A final exam that covers all the material learned throughout the term.
option_c: A quiz and brainstorming at the beginning of class to check for prior knowledge.
option_d: A standardized test used to compare students across the country.
explanation: A project rubric is assessment for learning.

question: Assertion (A): As compared to boys, girls have an innate tendency to be affected more by social and cultural factors. Reason (R): Girls are genetically more sensitive and emotionally weaker than boys, making it more likely for them to conform to societal expectations.
option_b: Both (A) and (R) are true and (R) is the correct explanation of (A)
option_c: Both (A) and (R) are true but (R) is not the correct explanation of (A)
explanation: Both gender-innateness claims are false.

question: Assertion (A): 12-years Amana gets scared every time the teacher asks her to answer or solve the maths problem on the blackboard because she fears that the teacher will scold her and she would be embarrassed. Reason (R): When students feel unsafe and anxious their learning is adversely affected.
option_b: Both (A) and (R) are true and (R) is the correct explanation of (A)
option_c: Both (A) and (R) are true but (R) is not the correct explanation of (A)
explanation: Anxiety harms learning; reason explains the assertion.

question: A teacher wants to enable meaningful and analytical learning in her class by providing opportunities for students to connect their prior knowledge to new concepts. Which teaching strategy would be most effective?
option_a: Providing students with a step-by-step guide on how to complete a task related to the new material.
option_b: Lecturing on new material and providing students with a list of key terms to memorize.
option_c: Assign students to read the textbook chapter and answer questions at the end.
option_d: Ask students to share their own experiences related to the new material and then connect them to the topic.
explanation: Connecting prior experience to new topics aids learning.

question: In an inclusive classroom the teacher:
option_a: Tries to encourage children to do better by promoting competitive spirit.
option_b: Identifies 'deficits' in children and correctly labels them.
option_c: Segregates children based on differing academic capabilities.
option_d: Modifies the curriculum and pedagogical strategies to suit varied needs of children.
explanation: Inclusive teacher adapts curriculum to varied needs.

question: Which of the following Kingdoms was established by Kadamba Mayurasharman?
explanation: Kadamba Mayurasharman established a kingdom in Karnataka.

question: Which of the following statements is/are correct about planets? (A) They are lit by the light of the stars (B) They are made up of only rocks (C) All planets have their moons
explanation: Only statement A about planets is correct.

question: The most important factor that influences the distribution of temperature on earth is:
explanation: Insolation most influences earth's temperature distribution.

question: Consider the following statements on non-Brahman movement and choose the valid option: (a) The movement came from non-Brahman castes that had acquired access to education (b) The movement argued that the Aryans were the indigenous people (c) The movement came from non-Brahman castes with wealth and influence
explanation: Non-Brahman movement from educated, wealthy non-Brahman castes.

question: Who among the following worked with leather workers in Central India and also started Satnami Movement?
explanation: Ghasidas started the Satnami Movement in Central India.

question: What type of winds are Land and Sea breeze?
explanation: Land and sea breezes are local winds.

question: While teaching in a Social Science class, a student asks you-how can we measure the distance between longitudes on Equator? What answer will be correct for such calculation?
option_a: Dividing the double length of Equator with 90
option_b: Dividing the total length of Equator with 180
option_c: Dividing the total length of Equator with 360
option_d: Dividing the half length of Equator with 360
explanation: Divide equator's total length by 360 for longitude distance.

question: Which of the following is the correct sequence of rock cycle?
option_c: Igneous Rock, Metamorphic Rock, Sedimentary Rock
explanation: Rock cycle: sedimentary, metamorphic, magma sequence.

question: Match the following and choose the appropriate option: (a) Punch marked coins (b) Northern Black polished ware (c) Amphorae (d) Arretine ware; (i) Stamped glazed pottery (ii) Tall double handled jars (iii) Extremely fine pottery (iv) Stamped with symbols/die
explanation: Coins-die, NBPW-glazed, amphorae-jars, arretine-fine pottery.

question: Read the statements (A) and (R): (A) Using resources carefully and giving them time to get renewed is called resource conservation. (R) Balancing the need to use resources and also conserve them for the future is called sustainable development.
option_b: Both the statements (A) and (R) are true and (R) explains (A)
option_c: Both the statements (A) and (R) are true but (R) does not explain (A)
explanation: Both conservation and sustainability statements true, unrelated.

question: Which one of the following is incorrect?
option_a: The dissatisfaction with British rule intensified in 1870s and 1880s.
option_b: The Arms Act was passed in 1878, disallowing Indians from possessing arms.
option_c: The Vernacular Press Act was passed in 1880, to support the Government.
option_d: In 1883, there was a furore over the attempt by the Government to introduce the Ilbert Bill.
explanation: Vernacular Press Act (1878) curbed, not supported press.

question: Consider the following statements about grasslands: (A) Climate plays an important role in the formation of grasslands. (B) Annual rainfall is moderate in Prairies while velds could face drought in winter months. (C) The vegetation cover is sparse in Velds. (D) Velds lie in the Northern Hemisphere while Prairies in the Southern Hemisphere.
explanation: Statements A, B and C about grasslands are correct.

question: According to the Uttaramerur inscription, who could become a member of a Sabha?
option_a: The owners of land from which land revenue is collected.
option_b: They should be between 25 and 70 years of age.
option_c: They should have their own houses.
option_d: They should have knowledge of the Vedas.
explanation: Sabha member must own revenue-paying land (all conditions).

question: ______ refers to a situation where a person does not have resources and opportunities that are available to other persons.
explanation: Lack of resources others have is inequality.

question: Which of the following are correctly matched? (A) Subsistence Farming – Practiced to meet the needs of farmer's own family. (B) Intensive Subsistence Agriculture – Prevalent in the thickly populated areas. (C) Shifting Cultivation – People and animals move from place to place.
explanation: Subsistence and intensive farming descriptions matched correctly.

question: Read the statements (A) and (R): (A) Raja Rammohan Roy founded a reform association known as the Brahmo Sabha in Calcutta. (R) He felt that changes were necessary in society and unjust practices needed to be done away with.
option_b: Both (A) and (R) are true and (R) is the correct explanation of (A)
option_c: Both (A) and (R) are true but (R) is not the correct explanation of (A)
explanation: Roy founded Brahmo Sabha; reason correctly explains.

question: Match the following: (a) Grihapatis (b) Shrenis (c) Adimai (d) Arikamedu; (i) Landless Labourers (ii) Independent farmers (iii) Coastal Settlement (iv) Craft persons
explanation: Grihapati-farmer, shreni-craft, adimai-landless, arikamedu-coastal.

question: World Environment Day is celebrated every year on which one of the following days?
explanation: World Environment Day is celebrated on 5th June.

question: Which of the following is true about common property resources? (A) These are owned by government (B) These are owned by private companies (C) These are owned by communities
explanation: Common property resources owned by government and communities.

question: Maps can be best used for ______.
option_a: Marking places where people have lived at different points in history
option_b: Arranging sequence of events in history
option_c: Elaborating on the most important events in history
option_d: Studying lives of people living in different times in a logical sequence
explanation: Maps best mark places people lived across history.

question: Which of the following statements are true about the development of cotton industries in the late 18th and early 19th century colonized India? (a) Indian textile industry had to compete with British textiles in the European and American markets. (b) British market was now available for Indian textiles. (c) Exporting textile goods to England became increasingly difficult. (d) Bengal weavers were worst hit as English and European companies stopped buying Indian textile.
explanation: Competition, export difficulty and Bengal weaver losses true.

question: Consider the statements (A) and (R): (A) The Prairies are also known as the 'Granaries of the world'. (R) Scientific methods of cultivation and use of tractors, harvesters and combines has made South Africa a surplus food producer.
option_b: Both (A) and (R) are true and (R) is the correct explanation of (A)
option_c: Both (A) and (R) are true but (R) is not the correct explanation of (A)
explanation: Prairies are granaries; South Africa reason is false.

question: Diversity came with something new and different due to ______.
explanation: Diversity arises from intermixing of cultures.

question: Reservation of seats in legislation and in Government jobs was granted by the Indian Constitution to:
option_a: Compensate for low grades and marks scored in School and University examinations.
option_b: Compensate for years of historical suppression and educational deprivation.
option_c: Appease people for political support and rally as vote banks.
explanation: Reservation compensates historical suppression and educational deprivation.

question: Read the statements (A) and (R) considering the art forms in colonial India: Assertion (A): Colonial rule introduced several new art forms, styles and techniques. Reason (R): These were creatively adapted by Indian artists for local patrons and markets.
option_b: Both (A) and (R) are true and (R) is the correct explanation of (A)
option_c: Both (A) and (R) are true but (R) is not the correct explanation of (A)
explanation: Colonial art forms adapted by Indian artists locally.

question: Neolithic sites are different than Paleolithic sites because of the following: (i) Mortars and pestles were used for grinding grains. (ii) Pots were used for cooking food. (iii) Cloth was woven using different kinds of material. (iv) Use of stone tools began.
explanation: Neolithic: grinding, cooking pots and weaving distinguish it.

question: Read the given Assertion (A) and Reason (R): Assertion (A): By the late 19th century, the craft of iron smelting declined and in most villages, furnaces fell into disuse. Reason (R): The iron smelters had to pay a very high tax to the Forest Department that reduced their income.
option_b: Both (A) and (R) are true and (R) is the correct explanation of (A)
option_c: Both (A) and (R) are true but (R) is not the correct explanation of (A)
explanation: Iron smelting declined; high forest tax explains it.

question: Who among the following are elected members of the Local Governments? (A) Ward member (B) Panchayat president (C) Secretary (D) Ward councilor
explanation: Ward member, panchayat president and councilor are elected.

question: On which of the following dates Gandhiji asked the Indian people to observe a day of non-violent opposition to the 'Rowlatt Act'?
explanation: Gandhi called Rowlatt Act protest on 6 April 1919.

question: When it is 1:00 p.m. at Greenwich, what time will it be at 60° West and 60° East respectively?

Consider the statements (A) and (B): Statement (A): Summative assessment monitors the learner's progress throughout the teaching-learning process. Statement (B): Formative assessment is conducted at the end of the course.
explanation: Both statements swap summative and formative; both false.

question: Which of the following questions promote critical thinking? (A) What are the different ways through which the Government can take steps to provide healthcare for all? Discuss. (B) Examine the statement: As compared to Amazon, pollution in river Ganga will affect human life greatly. (C) Differentiate between the physiography of Brazil and India. (D) Describe important features of Himalayas. (E) What was the role of the Zamindar in Mughal administration?
explanation: Discuss and examine questions promote critical thinking.

question: Select the reason behind the low wages paid for agricultural labourers:
option_a: They are satisfied with wages prevailing in the market.
option_c: They depend on land owners for a regular work.
option_d: Most of them do not have their own land.
explanation: Low wages due to dependence on land owners.

question: Social Science curricular activities can be made more engaging for students by ______.
option_a: Reducing critical thinking and discussion in favour of lectures.
option_c: focusing only on the most important historical events and figures.
option_d: Emphasizing memorization of facts and figures.
explanation: Technology and multimedia make Social Science engaging.

question: Match the following: (A) Narration charts (B) Relationship charts (C) Flow charts (D) Tabulation charts; (i) Steps in a process (ii) Data in the form of table (iii) Historical development (iv) Show cause-and-effect relationships
explanation: Narration-historical, relationship-cause, flow-steps, tabulation-table.

question: The Independence of Judiciary implies:
option_a: The judiciary can work under the pressure of legislature, if required.
option_b: The legislature and the executive cannot interfere in the work of the judiciary.
option_c: The judiciary can direct the legislature to frame appropriate laws.
option_d: The judiciary can direct the executive to implement the laws properly.
explanation: Judicial independence bars legislative and executive interference.

question: Which one of the following statements is correct regarding the nature of Social Science? (A) Social Science is a dynamic subject that generates debate and discussion. (B) In Social Science only individual human relations are considered. (C) Social Science is primarily interdisciplinary subject with a focus on discovery and experimentation. (D) The scope of Social Science is very narrow.
explanation: Social Science is dynamic and interdisciplinary.

question: Sixty-Percent weightage is given by the teacher to open-ended questions in a Social Science question paper. Which skill does the teacher want to test among students through this strategy? (A) Writing skills only (B) Intrapersonal skills (C) Logical thinking and creative skills (D) Application and presentation skills
explanation: Open-ended questions test logical, creative, presentation skills.

question: Which of the following aspect is considered in the Right to Education Act, 2009 as part of evaluation procedures? (A) Confirm with the values enshrined in the Indian Constitution. (B) Examination should involve mainly summative assessment. (C) Development of the physical abilities of learners to the fullest extent. (D) Examinations are conducted within the school premises.
explanation: RTE evaluation: constitutional values, physical development, school premises.

question: Read the statements (A) and (B): Statement (A): Contemporary challenges to the principle of a democratic society are conflicts such as those between individual rights and social responsibilities. Statement (B): Within a social science classroom, conflict resolution approach could be used to engage students to study 'Problems of democracy'.
explanation: Both democracy-conflict statements are true.

question: Indian Constitution lays down ______.
option_a: Norms for participation of people into social movements that seek to challenge the Government.
option_c: The basic laws or rules that have to be followed by everyone.
explanation: Constitution lays down basic laws everyone must follow.

question: The objective of establishing Panchayati Raj institutions in India was to achieve ______. (A) Participatory governance (B) Cultural homogeneity (C) Democratic decentralization (D) Religious diversity
explanation: Panchayati Raj aimed at participatory governance, decentralization.

question: Which of the following topics are highly appropriate for middle level students? (A) Contribution of Mahatma Gandhi in history (B) Economic development of India (C) Status of Women in present scenario (D) Reasons for population growth
explanation: Gandhi's contribution and women's status suit middle-level.

question: How can a Social Studies teacher develop social values among students? (i) Developing sense of discipline (ii) Behaving in the appropriate manner in school/class (iii) Asking Students to watch commercial movies (iv) Follow appropriate democratic values in class/school setting
explanation: Discipline, appropriate behaviour, democratic values build social values.

question: Which one of the following teaching methods are suitable to overcome the teaching challenges faced in Social Sciences?
explanation: Teaching from known to unknown overcomes challenges.

question: What does it mean to use the dialectic approach to teaching in the Social Science classroom?
option_a: Using maps and atlases to enrich students' understanding of Geography.
option_b: Using dialogue between student and teacher as the main method of knowledge generation.
option_c: Using drama in the classroom to generate interest in students.
option_d: Using examples and analogies to clarify abstract concepts.
explanation: Dialectic approach uses dialogue to generate knowledge.

question: Which of the following questions asked by the teacher come under the category of exploratory and critical questions? (A) What is the southernmost part of the Himalayas called? (B) Is the Sun a star? Why? (C) Why does more population reside in the Northern plains? (D) Between which two countries is the Pak Water Treaty located?
explanation: Why-questions B and C are exploratory and critical.

question: Small workshops and factories prefer to employ casual workers because ______. (A) State has already taken care of workers' benefits. (B) They can be fired without any prior notice. (C) Most of them are not literate. (D) They could be paid lowest possible wages.
explanation: Casual workers fired without notice and underpaid.

question: Nelson Mandela spent 28 years of imprisonment along with thousands of black and colored people:
option_a: To raise voice against King and royal monarchy.
option_b: For opposing apartheid and struggle against policies of segregation.
option_d: To get powerful positions in Government.
explanation: Mandela imprisoned for opposing apartheid and segregation.

question: Which of the following is an incorrect statement about Gram Sabha?
option_a: The Gram Sabha Secretary keeps a record of the Gram Sabha meeting proceedings.
option_b: The work of the Gram Panchayat has to be approved by the Gram Sabha.
option_c: The Gram Sabha Secretary is an elected person.
option_d: The Gram Sabha Secretary is responsible for calling the meeting of Gram Sabha and Gram Panchayat.
explanation: Gram Sabha Secretary is appointed, not elected (incorrect).

question: Which of the following emerged as an important religion in modern Adivasi history, during the nineteenth century?
explanation: Christianity emerged among Adivasis in nineteenth century.

question: Consider the following statements (A) and (B): (A) The Government of India Act 1909, allowed for some elected representation system in India. (B) Through Government of India Act 1909 all adults were given the right to vote.
explanation: 1909 Act allowed limited elected representation, not universal vote.

question: Critical thinking is important in Social Science because: (A) It helps students to pass exam. (B) It allows students to guess the correct answer. (C) It helps students memorize information more easily. (D) It prepares students for higher-level-thinking. (E) It promotes problem-solving abilities.
explanation: Critical thinking prepares higher-order thinking and problem-solving.

question: Which would be the best teaching pedagogy to understand the trends in poverty in Indian States and Union Territories?
explanation: Secondary data analysis best studies poverty trends.

question: Which of the following questions assess the evaluation aspect of cognitive abilities? (a) Poshan Abhiyan is an important program... Examine the statement with evidences. (b) Colonial rule in India for two centuries left India with irreversible social change. Do you agree? Explain. (c) Describe the important features of Jan Dhan Yojana. (d) Poverty and unemployment in India has declined in the post 1991 India. Justify this statement.
explanation: Examine and agree/explain questions assess evaluation.

question: The teacher divides the children of her class into 4 groups and gives them to write the names of the sources of water and then discusses the sources of water with each group. Which of the following he/she is attempting first as part of 5E approach to lesson plan?
explanation: Writing water sources first is the Engage phase.

question: A teacher wants students to understand the functioning of governmental bodies like Village Panchayat. Which of the following source of data collection will provide first-hand and authentic information?
explanation: Field trip gives first-hand Panchayat functioning information.

question: A belief that science requires a technical mind and girls and women are not capable of dealing with technical things signifies:
explanation: Belief that girls can't do science is stereotype.

question: In a field trip which is the first skill to be developed among students?
explanation: Observation is the first skill developed on field trips.

question: Rohit found that some children in his class could not explain the position of latitude and longitude lines on the map. What should Rohit do to help children acquire this competency?
explanation: Action research helps solve this classroom competency problem.

question: The word opposite in meaning to the underlined word in the given sentence is: 'Right use of colours actually helps you create the spacious feeling'.
explanation: Opposite of spacious is cramped.

question: Identify the parts of speech of the underlined words in the sentence given below: 'Right use of colours actually helps you create the spacious feeling'.
explanation: 'Actually' is adverb; 'feeling' is noun.

question: As mentioned by the writer in para 2, some ways by which you can break the monotony of the room is:
option_a: by blending light and dark shades
option_b: by painting all the 4 walls in plain colours
explanation: Blending shades breaks monotony; plain colours do not.

question: 'To think out of the box' does not mean to think:
explanation: Thinking out of box is not thinking traditionally.

question: According to the writer, it is important to pay attention to the colour scheme of your home because:
option_a: the monotonous shades add life to the rooms
option_b: the ambience created makes it look boring
option_c: it reflects the personality of the owner
option_d: the walls reveal the secrets of your life
explanation: Colour scheme reflects the owner's personality.

question: Read the following statements: (A) Colours if used creatively can give the perfect look to a room. (B) Space is abundant nowadays. (C) The right colour combination on walls and the roof creates a spacious feeling.
explanation: A and C correct; space abundance (B) incorrect.

question: Complete the given word analogy: monotonous : dull :: ambience : ______?
explanation: Ambience matches aura as monotonous matches dull.

question: Some people draw colourful sceneries on their home walls to:
option_b: give a deeper significance to their home
explanation: Wall sceneries bring nature into the home.

question: As mentioned by the writer in para 1, In today's times, what is a modern day home owner longing for?
explanation: Modern home owner longs for space.

question: The poetic devices in line 2 and line 4 are:
explanation: Line 2 uses simile; line 4 uses alliteration.

question: What is the overall tone of the poem?
explanation: Poem's tone is nostalgic and admiring.

question: Complete the word analogy: coarse : rough :: snug : ______?
explanation: Snug matches comfortable as coarse matches rough.

question: How does the speaker's father feel about his son's choice of career?
option_a: He is ambivalent towards the choice.
option_b: The poem doesn't make it clear.
option_c: He wishes his son choose a more practical path.
option_d: He is glad his son is not a farmer.
explanation: Father's feeling about son's career is unclear.

question: In the second stanza, the poet is observing:
explanation: Poet observes his father digging potatoes.

question: '............ loving their cool harness in our hands.' What is the speaker referring to in the given line?
explanation: Speaker refers to the freshly picked potatoes.

question: 'Authenticity of materials' refers to:
option_a: materials which children bring from home.
option_b: materials written by the teacher for her class.
option_c: materials written or developed by people in authority.
option_d: materials written or developed in real life content.
explanation: Authentic materials come from real-life content.

question: Aparna, a learner of class V understands that listening involves listening to each sound, words, then sentences to get the meaning of the speech or an audio. Which approach/strategy she believes in for learning to listen?
option_a: It is neither top-down nor bottom-up approach
explanation: Sound-to-meaning listening reflects bottom-up approach.

question: What is 'systemic competence' in language learning?
option_a: Understanding that all human have a systems of many languages.
option_b: Understanding and applying that language works as a system.
option_c: Understanding and applying that languages have a grammatical system.
option_d: Understanding that all languages have a common structural system.
explanation: Systemic competence: language functions as a system.

question: Here is text or some statements. Find out which language register does this text represent? 'The Indian Constitution recognises every person as equal...'
explanation: Constitution text uses the social science register.

question: A teacher of class VI does a warm up activity to connect their previous knowledge and experience with the text they would read. She asks her learners to look at the illustrations of the reading text (the story) before she begin to teach the text. What does she want her learners to do?
option_b: Visualize the story through the illustrations.
option_d: Make prediction about the reading text.
explanation: Illustration warm-up prompts predicting the reading text.

question: A continuous record of instances of learning by the learners is known as:
explanation: Continuous record of learning is a portfolio.

question: Which of the following are known as receptive skills?
explanation: Listening and reading are receptive skills.

question: Many Indians who go abroad for jobs learn the language of the place. What is this motivation known as?
option_a: It is neither instrumental nor integrative motivation.
explanation: Learning language for a job is instrumental motivation.

question: Which of the following language is NOT a classical language?
explanation: Hindi is not a classical language.

question: Which of the following is NOT true of the National Education Policy (NEP) 2020 on the study of foreign languages?
option_a: French is one of the language recommended to be studied as an additional option.
option_b: Study of foreign languages as an additional option during the secondary stage.
option_c: Study of foreign languages included as one of the languages under the three language formula.
option_d: Foreign language does not include in the three languages studied under three language formula.
explanation: NEP does not include foreign language in three-language formula.

question: Which of the following refers to 'Knowing about language'?
explanation: Knowing about language is declarative knowledge.

question: A teacher of class VI develops the following task for a speaking activity. 'Speak five sentences about desert and its climatic conditions.' Is it a good task or not a good task? Select from option your response and reason for the same.
option_a: It is not a good task because it lacks context as there is no input for speaking about desert and its conditions.
option_b: It is a good task because the learners may have studied about desert in their geography class and will have inputs to speak.
option_c: It is a good task because it makes the learner to talk about something i.e. the desert.
option_d: It is not a good task because some of the learners may not know about desert.
explanation: Task is poor because it lacks speaking context/input.

question: Which of the following statements is true of a dialect of a language? (a) Sometime different social group may speak different dialects of the same language. (b) Dialects of language vary from region to region. (c) Speakers of different dialects of one language can understand the other dialect speaker. (d) A dialect is a bigger category and language is a smaller category.
option_d: All the options are correct (Commission answer: z)
explanation: Commission accepted all dialect statements as correct.

question: Which of the following tasks promotes integrated learning skills?
explanation: Project work promotes integrated learning skills.

question: What is the following strategy in the context grammar teaching known as? Introducing language item in contexts, making learners notice the language items, enabling them to use it in real life contexts and drawing the attention of learner to the form by discovering it.
explanation: Context-based form noticing is consciousness raising.

question: 'संस्कृति पर तरह-तरह के प्रभाव पड़ते हैं' यह बात कैसे समझी जा सकती है?
option_a: शिक्षा को पृथक रूप से देखा जाए।
option_b: जब शिक्षा को धर्म से जोड़कर देखा जाए।
option_c: जब शिक्षा को संस्कृति से अलग करके देखा जाए।
option_d: जब शिक्षा को संस्कृति से जोड़कर देखा जाए।
explanation: शिक्षा को संस्कृति से जोड़कर प्रभाव समझे जाते हैं।

question: इनमें से कौन-सा शब्द समूहों से भिन्न है?
explanation: आदान-प्रदान क्रिया है, शेष संज्ञा समूह हैं।

question: गद्यांश के अनुसार कौन-सा वाक्य सही है?
option_b: संस्कृति की मुख्य विशेषता उसका एकाकीपन है।
option_c: संस्कृति में किसी भी प्रकार का आदान-प्रदान नहीं होता है।
option_d: संस्कृति में गतिशीलता का अभाव है।
explanation: संस्कृति सदैव प्रगतिशील और ग्रहणशील है।

question: किस शब्द में 'इक' प्रत्यय का प्रयोग हुआ है?
explanation: 'सामाजिक' में इक प्रत्यय प्रयुक्त हुआ है।

question: 'कोई भी संस्कृति किसी देशकाल के सापेक्ष होती है।' इस वाक्य से आशय है:
option_a: संस्कृति किसी भी तरह से प्रभावित नहीं होती है।
option_b: संस्कृति और देश में घनिष्ठ संबंध है।
option_c: संस्कृति समय एवं स्थान के अनुसार स्वयं में परिवर्तन लाती है।
option_d: संस्कृति देश और काल में अंतर करती है।
explanation: संस्कृति समय-स्थान के अनुसार स्वयं बदलती है।

question: प्रचलित परंपराओं के औचित्य के बारे में सोचने की प्रेरणा कौन देता है?
explanation: शिक्षा परंपराओं के औचित्य पर सोचने को प्रेरित करती है।

question: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा शब्द कारक चिह्न नहीं है?
explanation: 'तथा' संयोजक है, कारक चिह्न नहीं।

question: शिक्षा संस्कृति की निर्मात्री है, क्योंकि:
option_a: वह परंपराओं को ज्यों का त्यों स्वीकारती है।
option_b: वह मौजूदा संस्कृति में कुछ नवीनता लाती है।
option_c: वह परंपराओं को रूढ़ रूप देती है।
explanation: शिक्षा संस्कृति में नवीनता लाकर निर्माण करती है।

question: शिक्षा को किस प्रकार के कार्य के रूप में देखा गया है?
explanation: शिक्षा को सांस्कृतिक कार्य के रूप में देखा गया।

question: पद्यांश में 'सिंहनाद' शब्द से आशय है-
explanation: 'सिंहनाद' यहाँ वीरों की ललकार का प्रतीक है।

question: 'कलम, आज उनकी जय बोल' पंक्ति से क्या अभिप्राय है?
option_a: लिखने की अपेक्षा बोलकर गुणगान किया जाए।
option_b: जय जयकार के नारे लगाए जाएँ।
option_c: देश के लिए समर्पित लोगों के लिए लिखा जाए।
option_d: सभी के लिए प्रशंसा के शब्द लिखे जाएँ।
explanation: कलम देशभक्त बलिदानियों के सम्मान में लिखे।

question: भिन्न शब्द समूह की पहचान करें-
explanation: 'जला अस्थियों' बलिदान-मृत्यु का, शेष प्रकाश/ऊर्जा के प्रतीक।

question: इस पद्यांश में कौन-सी भावना अभिव्यक्त हुई है?
explanation: पद्यांश में देशप्रेम की भावना अभिव्यक्त हुई है।

question: 'छिटकाई जिनने चिनगारी' पंक्ति में रेखांकित शब्द किसके लिए प्रयुक्त हुआ है?
explanation: 'चिनगारी' स्वतंत्रता सेनानियों के लिए प्रयुक्त हुई।

question: 'निस्वार्थ भाव से अपने प्राणों का बलिदान कर दिया।' यह भाव किस पंक्ति में मुखरित हुआ है?
option_b: किसी दिन माँगा नहीं स्नेह मुँह खोल।
option_c: सहमी धरती रही अभी तक डोल।
option_d: जो चढ़ गए पुण्य वेदी पर लिए बिना गरदन का मोल।
explanation: निस्वार्थ बलिदान भाव अंतिम पंक्ति में मुखरित।

question: सामग्री की प्रामाणिकता किससे संबंधित है?
option_a: वह सामग्री जो बच्चे घर से लेकर आते हैं।
option_b: अध्यापक द्वारा अपनी कक्षा के लिए लिखी गई सामग्री।
option_c: सत्तासीन लोगों द्वारा विकसित या लिखित सामग्री।
option_d: जीवन के वास्तविक संदर्भों में विकसित या लिखित सामग्री।
explanation: प्रामाणिक सामग्री वास्तविक जीवन संदर्भों से आती है।

question: अपर्णा, कक्षा पाँच की शिक्षार्थी यह समझती है कि किसी आडियो या बातचीत का अर्थ समझने के लिए श्रवण में प्रत्येक ध्वनि, शब्दों फिर वाक्यों को सुनना शामिल है। वह श्रवण अधिगम के किस उपागम/युक्ति में विश्वास रखती है?
option_a: यह न तो टॉप डाउन है और न ही बॉटम-अप उपागम है
option_d: टॉप डाउन और बॉटम-अप दोनों उपागम
explanation: ध्वनि-से-अर्थ श्रवण बॉटम-अप उपागम दर्शाता है।

question: भाषा अधिगम में 'सर्वांगी (सिस्टमिक) दक्षता' क्या है?
option_a: इस बात की समझ कि सभी मनुष्यों के पास बहुत सी भाषाओं की व्यवस्थाएँ हैं।
option_b: इस बात को समझना और प्रयोग में लाना कि भाषा एक व्यवस्था के रूप में कार्य करती है।
option_c: इस बात को समझना और प्रयोग में लाना कि भाषाओं की एक व्याकरणिक व्यवस्था है।
option_d: इस बात को समझना कि सभी भाषाओं की एक सामान्य संरचनात्मक व्यवस्था है।
explanation: सर्वांगी दक्षता: भाषा एक व्यवस्था के रूप में।

question: यहाँ एक पाठ्य सामग्री या कुछ कथन हैं। पता लगाइए कि यह पाठ्य सामग्री किस भाषा प्रयुक्ति (रजिस्टर) का प्रतिनिधित्व कर रही है? 'भारत का संविधान प्रत्येक व्यक्ति को समान रूप से देखता है...'
explanation: संविधान पाठ सामाजिक विज्ञान प्रयुक्ति का है।

question: कक्षा छह की अध्यापक आज पढ़ी जाने वाली भाषा सामग्री को शिक्षार्थियों को पूर्व ज्ञान और अनुभव से जोड़ने के लिए 'वार्म अप' गतिविधि करवाती है। पाठ्य सामग्री पढ़ाना शुरू करने से पहले शिक्षार्थियों को पाठ्य सामग्री (कहानी) के चित्र देखने के लिए कहती है। वह अपने शिक्षार्थियों से क्या करवाना चाहती है?
option_a: चित्रों को समझने की क्षमता विकसित करना।
option_b: चित्रों के माध्यम से कहानी की मन में कल्पना कर पाना।
option_d: पाठ्य सामग्री के बारे में अनुमान लगाना।
explanation: चित्र वार्म-अप से पाठ का अनुमान लगवाना है।

question: शिक्षार्थियों द्वारा हुए अधिगम के उदाहरणों का सतत रूप रखा गया रिकार्ड क्या कहलाएगा?
explanation: अधिगम का सतत रिकार्ड पोर्टफोलियो कहलाता है।

question: निम्नलिखित में से किन्हें ग्रहणशील (रिसेप्टिव) कौशलों के रूप में जाना जाएगा?
explanation: श्रवण और पठन ग्रहणशील कौशल हैं।

question: बहुत से भारतीय जो नौकरी के लिए विदेश जाते हैं, वे उस स्थान की भाषा सीखते हैं। इस प्रेरणा को क्या कहा जाएगा?
option_a: यह न तो यांत्रिक है और न ही समाकलनात्मक है।
option_b: समाकलनात्मक और यांत्रिक दोनों प्रकार की प्रेरणा।
explanation: नौकरी हेतु भाषा सीखना यांत्रिक प्रेरणा है।

question: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सी शास्त्रीय भाषा नहीं है?
explanation: हिंदी शास्त्रीय भाषा नहीं है।

question: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा विदेशी भाषाओं के अध्ययन के संबंध में राष्ट्रीय शिक्षा नीति 2020 के परिप्रेक्ष्य में सही नहीं है?
option_a: फ्रेंच को एक अतिरिक्त विकल्प के रूप में अनुशासित किया गया है।
option_b: माध्यमिक चरण के दौरान एक अतिरिक्त विकल्प के रूप में विदेशी भाषाओं का अध्ययन।
option_c: त्रिभाषा सूत्र के अन्तर्गत भाषाओं में से एक के रूप में विदेशी भाषाओं का अध्ययन।
option_d: विदेशी भाषा को त्रिभाषा सूत्र के अन्तर्गत अध्ययन की जा रही तीन भाषाओं में शामिल नहीं किया गया है।
explanation: NEP त्रिभाषा सूत्र में विदेशी भाषा शामिल नहीं करती।

question: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा 'भाषा के बारे में जानना' से संबंधित है?
explanation: भाषा के बारे में जानना घोषणात्मक ज्ञान है।

question: कक्षा छह की अध्यापिका बोलने से संबंधित किसी गतिविधि के लिए निम्नलिखित कार्य तैयार करती है- ''रेगिस्तान और उसकी जलवायु स्थिति के बारे में कोई पाँच वाक्य बोलिए।'' क्या यह एक अच्छा या अच्छा कार्य नहीं है? अपने उत्तर और उत्तर के कारण का चयन करें।
option_a: यह एक अच्छा कार्य नहीं है क्योंकि इसमें संदर्भ की कमी है क्योंकि उन्हें रेगिस्तान और उसकी स्थितियों के बारे में कुछ नहीं बताया गया है।
option_b: यह एक अच्छा कार्य है क्योंकि शिक्षार्थियों ने भूगोल की किताब में रेगिस्तान के बारे में पढ़ा होगा।
option_c: यह एक अच्छा कार्य है क्योंकि यह शिक्षार्थी को बोलने के लिए तैयार करता है।
option_d: यह अच्छा कार्य नहीं है क्योंकि कुछ शिक्षार्थी रेगिस्तान के बारे में नहीं जानते होंगे।
explanation: संदर्भ के अभाव में यह अच्छा कार्य नहीं है।

question: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा कथन भाषा की बोली के बारे में सही है? (a) कभी-कभी विभिन्न सामाजिक समूहों के लोग एक भाषा की विभिन्न बोलियाँ बोलते हैं। (b) भाषा की बोलियाँ एक क्षेत्र से दूसरे क्षेत्र में भिन्न-भिन्न होती हैं। (c) एक भाषा की विभिन्न बोलियाँ बोलने वाले दूसरी बोली बोलने वाले की बात समझ पाते हैं। (d) बोली एक बड़ी श्रेणी है और भाषा तुलनात्मक रूप से छोटी श्रेणी में आती है।
option_d: सभी विकल्प सही हैं (आयोग का उत्तर: z)
explanation: आयोग ने सभी बोली-कथनों को सही माना।

question: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा कार्य समेकित अधिगम कौशलों को समुन्नत करता है?

question: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सी युक्ति 'संदर्भ में व्याकरण शिक्षण' से संबंधित है? संदर्भ में भाषा की सामग्री प्रस्तुत करना, सामग्री की ओर ध्यान दिलाना, जीवन की वास्तविक परिस्थितियों में भाषा प्रयोग के योग्य बनाना और शिक्षार्थियों का ध्यान खोज-बीन के द्वारा उसके नियमों की ओर दिलाना।
explanation: संदर्भगत व्याकरण शिक्षण सचेतनता जागृत करना है।

question: पक्षिवासार्थं प्रयुक्तं पदं चित्वा लिखत।

question: 'हृदि' इति पदे का विभक्तिः प्रयुक्ता?

explanation: कच्छपः लघुकाष्ठम् आनेतुं कथितवान्।

question: कम्बुग्रीवेण अधोभागे किं आलोकितम्?

question: 'ऊचुः' इति क्रियापदस्य धातुनिर्देशं कुरुत।

question: कस्यार्थे पृथिवीं त्यजेत्?

question: पञ्चमकक्षायाः विद्यार्थी अपर्णा जानाति यत् श्रवणान्तरे वाचः श्रव्यस्य व अर्थ अवगन्तुं ध्वनि-पद-वाक्यविशेषस्य श्रवणं सन्निविष्टं भवति। सा श्रवण-अधिगमहेतोः किं प्रविधिं स्वीकरोति?
option_a: न खलु अधोगामि उपागमः न उपरिगामि उपागमः

question: भाषा अधिगमे, तन्त्रबद्धं सामर्थ्यं (Systemic Competence) किं कथ्यते?

option_d: सर्वभाषासु एका संकीर्णसंरचना व्यवस्था प्राप्यते इति अवबोधः।
explanation: भाषा एकं तन्त्रवत् इति अवबोधः तन्त्रबद्धं सामर्थ्यम्।

question: अत्र एकः पाठः उदाहृतः। अनेन पाठेन का भाषा-पर्युक्तिः (Language register) सम्बद्धः अस्ति? 'भारतीय-संविधान-अनुसारं प्रत्येकं व्यक्तिः समानः अस्ति...'
explanation: संविधान-पाठः समाज-विज्ञान-पर्युक्त्या सम्बद्धः।

question: षष्ठकक्षायाः एका शिक्षिका स्वच्छात्रान् तेभ्यः पठिष्यमाणपाठं तेषां पूर्वज्ञान-अनुभवाभ्यां सह संयोजयितुं कथयति। सा स्वपाठं पाठयितुं पूर्वमपि पाठे विद्यमानानि चित्राणि अवलोकयितुं कथयति। सा स्वच्छात्रैः किं कर्तुम् इच्छति?
explanation: चित्रावलोकनेन पाठमुद्दिश्य पूर्वानुमानकरणम् इच्छति।

explanation: सम्पादित-अधिगम-उदाहरणानां सततसंसूचनं पत्राधानम्।

question: अधोलिखितेषु किं ग्रहण-कौशलानि (Receptive Skills) इति ज्ञायते?

question: सेवायोजनाय विदेशं गन्तुकामाः बहवः भारतीयाः तद्देशानां भाषां शिक्षन्ते। भाषा शिक्षणस्य इयं उत्प्रेरणा का कथ्यते?
explanation: सेवायोजनार्थं भाषाशिक्षणं करणमूला उत्प्रेरणा।

question: अधोलिखितेषु का भाषा श्रेण्यभाषा (Classical Language) नास्ति?
explanation: हिन्दीभाषा श्रेण्यभाषा नास्ति।

question: वैदेशिक-भाषाध्ययनमधिकृत्य राष्ट्रीय-शिक्षा-नीति 2020 विषये अधोलिखितेषु किं सत्यं न अस्ति?
option_a: अतिरिक्त विकल्परूपेण फ्रेन्चभाषायाः गणना अनुशंसितभाषासु मध्ये भवति।
option_c: त्रिभाषासूत्रमध्ये एका भाषा इति वैदेशिकभाषायाः अध्ययनम्।
option_d: त्रिभाषासूत्रमध्ये अधीतभाषासु काऽपि वैदेशिकभाषा सन्निविष्टा नास्ति।
explanation: NEP त्रिभाषासूत्रे वैदेशिकभाषा न सन्निविष्टा।

question: अधोलिखितेषु किं 'भाषामुद्दिश्य ज्ञानक्रियाः' संकेतयति?
explanation: 'भाषामुद्दिश्य ज्ञानक्रियाः' निर्णयात्मकं ज्ञानं संकेतयति।

question: षष्ठकक्षायाः एकः अध्यापकः सम्भाषण-गतिविधिद्वष्ट्या अधोलिखितं कार्यम् आयोजयति— मरुस्थलं तद्जलवायुस्थितीं च उद्दिश्य पञ्चवाक्यानि वदतु। किमियं कार्यं समीचीनं वा असमीचीनम्?
option_a: इदं तु असमीचीनं कार्यं यतोहि अस्मिन् सन्दर्भाभावः दृश्यते यतः मरुस्थलमुद्दिश्य संभाषणाय निविष्टीनां अभावः प्राप्यते।
option_b: इदं एकं समीचीनं कार्यं यतो हि छात्रैः पूर्वमेव स्वभूगोलकक्षायां मरुस्थल-विषये अधीतम्।
option_c: इदं समीचीनं कार्यं यतो हि इदं छात्रान् किंचित् विषयमुद्दिश्य यथा मरुस्थलं, वक्तुं प्रवर्तते।
option_d: इदं तु असमीचीनं कार्यं यतोहि केचित् छात्राः मरुस्थलविषये न अधीतवन्तः।
explanation: सन्दर्भाभावात् इदं कार्यम् असमीचीनम्।

question: कस्याश्चिद् भाषायाः उपभाषा (Dialect) विषये अधोलिखितेषु किं सत्यम्?

option_d: उपभाषा एकः महत्तरः कोटिः भाषा तु एकः लघुतरः कोटिः।
explanation: उपभाषायाः क्षेत्रगत भिन्नता सत्यम् (आयोग: z)।

question: अधोलिखितेषु किं समेकित-अधिगम-कौशलानि संवर्धयति?
