version_note: Alternative language version of the same Language-II slot
question: 'छात्रेभ्यः भाषायाः परिचयः दातव्यः, एवं त्रुटयः अस्य प्रमाणाः भवन्ति यत् अधिगमः प्रवर्तते' - अस्य समर्थनं केन कृतम्?
explanation: इसका समर्थन संज्ञानवादियों द्वारा किया गया है।

version_note: Alternative language version of the same Language-II slot
question: अधोलिखितेषु किं कथनं सत्यं अस्ति? (1) डिस्लैक्सिया (Dyslexia) एकं पठनवैकल्यम् अस्ति (2) डिस्ग्रेफिया (Dysgraphia) एकं लेखनवैकल्यम् अस्ति (3) डिस्ग्रेफिया (Dysgraphia) एकं पठनवैकल्यम् अस्ति (4) डिस्लैक्सिया (Dyslexia) एकं लेखनवैकल्यम् अस्ति
explanation: डिस्लैक्सिया पठन वैकल्य और डिस्ग्रेफिया लेखन वैकल्य है।

version_note: Alternative language version of the same Language-II slot
question: रीता, एका राजकीयविद्यालयस्य अध्यापिका, सप्तमकक्षायाः छात्रान् आङ्ग्लभाषाध्यापनार्थं दृश्ययन्त्राणां भाषाक्रीडानां च प्रयोगं करोति। सा अध्यापनस्य कं सिद्धान्तं योजयति?
explanation: रीता प्रेरणा और रुचि के सिद्धान्त को योजित करती है।

version_note: Alternative language version of the same Language-II slot
question: एका लघुकथा यस्यां मुख्यपात्ररूपेण जन्तवः भवन्ति, सुस्पष्टशिक्षाः च शिक्षते, कथ्यते-
explanation: पशु पात्रों वाली शिक्षाप्रद लघुकथा नीतिकथा (फेबल) कहलाती है।

question: In an inclusive classroom, adaptations should be made in / एक समावेशी कक्षा में अनुकूलन किसमें किया जाना चाहिए?
explanation: Inclusive adaptation applies to learning goals, strategies, support and assessment.

question: Which of the following does not come under the category of sensory impairments? / निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सी अक्षमता संवेदी बाधिता के अंतर्गत नहीं आती है?
option_b: Hard of hearing / श्रवण में कठिनाई
option_c: Partial loss of vision / दृष्टि की आंशिक हानि
explanation: Dysgraphia is a learning disability, not a sensory impairment.

question: According to Jean Piaget, cognitive development: / जीन पियाजे के अनुसार संज्ञानात्मक विकास:
option_a: Is dependent upon the development of language capabilities. / भाषा क्षमताओं के विकास पर निर्भर है।
option_b: Is the process of acquiring the ability to use cultural tools. / सांस्कृतिक उपकरणों का उपयोग करने की योग्यता प्राप्त करने की प्रक्रिया है।
option_c: Is the process of adaption to the environment by changing one's schemas. / किसी के स्कीमा को बदलकर पर्यावरण के अनुकूलन की प्रक्रिया है।
option_d: Is simple addition of new facts and ideas to the existing store of information. / मौजूदा भंडार में नए तथ्यों और विचारों का सरल जोड़ है।
explanation: Piaget saw cognition as adaptation via changing schemas to the environment.

question: National Education Policy (NEP) 2020 emphasizes on transforming assessment by: / राष्ट्रीय शिक्षा नीति (एनईपी) 2020 आकलन में क्या बदलाव करने की सिफारिश करती है?
option_a: Executing summative form of assessment / आकलन के योगात्मक रूप को क्रियान्वित करने की
option_b: Incorporating self-assessment and peer-assessment / स्व-मूल्यांकन और सहकर्मी-मूल्यांकन को शामिल करने की
option_c: Practicing unitary notion of intelligence / बुद्धि की एकात्मक धारणा को लागू करने की
option_d: Devaluing socio-cultural context of students / छात्रों के सामाजिक-सांस्कृतिक संदर्भ का अवमूल्यन करने की
explanation: NEP 2020 promotes self and peer assessment over summative rote testing.

question: When learning new information, which of the following is a helpful strategy for children to use to ensure they understand the content material? / नई जानकारी सीखते समय, बच्चों के लिए यह सुनिश्चित करने के लिए कि वे विषय-वस्तु को समझते हैं, कौन सी सहायक रणनीति है?
explanation: Rereading and asking questions help children understand new content material.

question: Assertion (A): If physical development of children is delayed then their social and emotional development gets affected. Reason (R): There is developmental continuity in the course of children's development. / अभिकथन-कारण प्रश्न
option_a: Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A.
option_b: A is true but R is false.
option_c: Both A and R are false.
option_d: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A.
explanation: Developmental continuity means delayed physical growth affects social-emotional domains.

question: Assertion (A): Male characters in stories and books are often presented as strong and adventurous while female characters are shown as warm and sensitive. Reason (R): Schools and curriculum influence gender-role identity as they are powerful agents of secondary socialization.
option_a: Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A.
option_b: A is true but R is false.
option_c: Both A and R are false.
option_d: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A.
explanation: Curricula as secondary socialization agents reinforce gender stereotypes in texts.

question: A teacher should create a classroom culture where students' motivation to learn is primarily focused to: / एक शिक्षक को ऐसे कक्षा वातावरण का निर्माण करना चाहिए जहाँ सीखने की अभिप्रेरणा मुख्य रूप से किस पर केंद्रित हो?
option_a: Compete with each other. / एक दूसरे के साथ प्रतिस्पर्धा करने पर
option_b: Understand and appreciate the process of learning. / सीखने की प्रक्रिया को समझने व उसकी सराहना करने पर
option_c: Prove their worth to others. / दूसरों के सामने अपनी काबिलियत साबित करने पर
option_d: Avoid shame of appearing ignorant. / अज्ञानी दिखने की शर्म से बचने पर
explanation: Intrinsic motivation focuses on understanding and appreciating the learning process.

question: Assertion (A): Children who are struggling with dyslexia have trouble in phonological processing that makes it hard to decode words. Reason (R): All children benefit from being encouraged in their areas of interest and ability.
option_a: Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A.
option_b: A is true but R is false.
option_c: Both A and R are false.
option_d: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A.
explanation: A on dyslexia is true; R is a general principle, not its explanation.

question: Which of the following is not an effective strategy in problem-solving? / निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सी समस्या-समाधान की एक प्रभावी युक्ति नहीं है?
option_a: Using logical reasoning to solve problems / समस्याओं को हल करने के लिए तार्किक तर्कशक्ति का प्रयोग करना
option_b: Overlooking relevant information / प्रासंगिक जानकारी को अनदेखा करना
option_c: Breaking down complex problems into simpler parts / जटिल समस्याओं को सरल भागों में विभाजित करना
option_d: Recognizing patterns and relationships / पैटर्न और संबंधों को पहचानना
explanation: Overlooking relevant information hinders effective problem-solving.

question: Assertion (A): When talking about differences, expressions that put the person ahead of the difference should be used such as 'the student with disabilities' rather than 'the disabled student'. Reason (R): The language we use when talking about learners with differing needs shapes the perspective and attitudes.
option_a: Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A.
option_b: A is true but R is false.
option_c: Both A and R are false.
option_d: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A.
explanation: Person-first language matters because language shapes attitudes toward disability.

question: According to Lawrence Kohlberg around which ethics do very young children's moral reasoning revolve? / लॉरेंस कोहलबर्ग के अनुसार बहुत छोटे बच्चों की नैतिक तर्कशक्ति किस नैतिकता के इर्द-गिर्द घूमती है?
option_a: Ethics of care / देखभाल की नैतिकता
option_b: Ethics of perspectives of others / दूसरों का परिप्रेक्ष्य लेने की नैतिकता
option_c: Ethics of laws / कानूनों की नैतिकता
option_d: Ethics of egocentricism / अहंकार की नैतिकता
explanation: Young children's moral reasoning revolves around egocentric ethics per Kohlberg.

question: Which of the following statements about learning is not correct? / सीखने के बारे में निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा कथन सही नहीं है?
option_a: New learning depends on current understanding. / नई सीख वर्तमान समझ पर निर्भर करती है।
option_b: Social interaction hinders learning. / सामाजिक संपर्क सीखने में बाधा डालता है।
option_c: The most meaningful learning occurs within real-world tasks. / सबसे सार्थक सीख दुनिया के प्रामाणिक कार्यों में होती है।
option_d: Learners construct knowledge that makes sense to them. / शिक्षार्थी उस ज्ञान की रचना करते हैं जो उनके लिए मायने रखता है।
explanation: Social interaction aids, not hinders, learning; this statement is incorrect.

question: Assertion (A): Children in middle schools should be encouraged to write about their emotions on a daily/weekly basis and reflect upon them. Reason (R): Understanding one's emotions is a cognitive process that can lead to action.
option_a: Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A.
option_b: A is true but R is false.
option_c: Both A and R are false.
option_d: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A.
explanation: Emotional writing helps because understanding emotions is a cognitive process.

question: According to constructivist theorists: / संरचनावादी सिद्धांतकारों के अनुसार:
option_a: Children learn only when extrinsically motivated. / बच्चे तभी सीखते हैं जब बाहरी रूप से प्रेरित हों।
option_b: Children learn best when information is presented to them in a final form. / बच्चे तब सबसे अच्छा सीखते हैं जब उनके सामने जानकारी अंतिम रूप से पूर्ण रूप में प्रस्तुत की जाती है।
option_c: Children have a tendency to behave in unruly ways that needs to be corrected. / बच्चों में अनियंत्रित व्यवहार करने की प्रवृत्ति होती है जिसे सुधारने की आवश्यकता होती है।
option_d: Children have a natural tendency to 'make sense' of the world. / बच्चों में दुनिया को 'समझने' की स्वाभाविक प्रवृत्ति होती है।
explanation: Constructivism holds children naturally make sense of their world.

question: Two commonly used strategies for effective problem-solving are? / प्रभावी समस्या-समाधान के लिए आमतौर पर इस्तेमाल की जाने वाली दो प्रभावी रणनीतियाँ कौन सी हैं?
option_a: Heuristics and functional fixedness / स्वानुभविक और कार्यात्मक स्थिरता
option_b: Algorithms and response set / कलन विधि और अनुक्रिया समुच्चय
option_c: Heuristics and response set / स्वानुभविक और अनुक्रिया समुच्चय
option_d: Heuristics and algorithms / स्वानुभविक और कलन विधि
explanation: Heuristics and algorithms are two common problem-solving strategies.

question: Assertion (A): Diversity and inclusion improve teaching and learning. Reason (R): Engaging in conversations across differences hinders children's ability to think critically and creatively.
option_a: Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A.
option_b: A is true but R is false.
option_c: Both A and R are false.
option_d: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A.
explanation: A is true; R is false since cross-difference dialogue aids critical thinking.

question: Rapid increase in height and weight during adolescence that usually precedes sexual maturity is referred to as: / किशोरावस्था के दौरान लंबाई और वजन में बढ़त जो आमतौर पर यौन परिपक्वता से पहले होती है, क्या कहलाती है?
explanation: The rapid adolescent height-weight increase is called the growth spurt.

question: Students feel more motivated to learn in an environment which ensures: / विद्यार्थी एक ऐसे वातावरण में सीखने के लिए अधिक अभिप्रेरित महसूस करता है जो सुनिश्चित करता है:
explanation: Belongingness and safety motivate students to learn.

question: A teacher is designing a lesson plan for a group of students with varying levels of understanding of a topic. According to Vygotsky's theory, which of the following should the teacher consider when designing the lesson?
option_a: The teacher should provide all students with the same level of challenge.
option_b: The teacher should consider each student's current level of understanding and provide appropriate support to help them reach the next level.
option_c: The teacher should only focus on the students who are already at an advanced level.
option_d: The teacher should ask each student to work individually on the specified problem.
explanation: Vygotsky: scaffold each student from current level to next via support.

question: Which of the following are effective teaching strategies to cater to diverse needs of learners in a classroom? / कक्षा में शिक्षार्थियों की विविध आवश्यकताओं को पूरा करने के लिए कौन सी प्रभावी शिक्षण रणनीतियाँ हैं?
option_c: Individualized Education plans / व्यक्तिगत शिक्षा योजनाएँ
explanation: Differentiated instruction and IEPs cater to diverse learner needs. (Key: b = a,c)

question: Characteristics such as 'lacking reading fluency', 'reversion of words', 'tendency towards distraction' are typical identifying characteristics of: / 'पढ़ने में प्रवाह की कमी', 'शब्दों का प्रत्यावर्तन', 'अन्यमनस्कता की प्रवृत्ति' जैसे विशिष्ट लक्षण किसकी पहचान के लक्षण हैं?
option_a: Autism spectrum Disorder / स्वलीनता स्पेक्ट्रम विकार
option_c: Attention Deficit hyperactivity Disorder / ध्यान न्यूनता अतिक्रियाशीलता विकार
explanation: Poor reading fluency and word reversal identify dyslexia.

question: Assertion (A): Teachers should avoid collaborations, group work and interactions among students. Reason (R): Learning is a passive process and occurs most effectively through memorization and imitation.
option_a: Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A.
option_b: A is true but R is false.
option_c: Both A and R are false.
option_d: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A.
explanation: Both statements contradict modern pedagogy; both are false.

question: Students learn efficiently and in meaningful ways when: / विद्यार्थी कुशलतापूर्वक और सार्थक तरीके से तब सीखते हैं जब:
option_a: Focus is on avoiding failure instead of approaching mastery. / निपुणता हासिल करने के बजाय असफलता से बचने पर ध्यान दिया जाता है।
option_b: New concept is completely different from previously learned material. / नई अवधारणा पहले सीखी गई विषय-वस्तु से पूरी तरह से अलग होती है।
option_c: Their responses and subjective experiences are attended and valued. / उनकी प्रतिक्रियाओं और व्यक्तिपरक अनुभवों पर ध्यान दिया जाता है और उन्हें महत्व दिया जाता है।
option_d: Content is presented to them in the form of incoherent pieces of information. / विषय-वस्तु को उन्हें जानकारी के असंगत टुकड़ों के रूप में प्रस्तुत किया जाता है।
explanation: Meaningful learning occurs when responses and subjective experiences are valued.

question: Assertion (A): Though height and body build are primarily inherited characteristics, good nutrition and exercise also make a difference. Reason (R): Heredity and environment interact in their effects on development.
option_a: Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A.
option_b: A is true but R is false.
option_c: Both A and R are false.
option_d: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A.
explanation: Heredity-environment interaction explains why nutrition affects inherited traits.

question: Moving from conservative education towards progressive education requires shift from ___. / रूढ़िवादी शिक्षा से प्रगतिशील शिक्षा की ओर बढ़ने के लिए किसकी आवश्यकता है?
option_a: Integrated curriculum to standardized curriculum / एकीकृत पाठ्यक्रम के स्थान पर मानकीकृत पाठ्यक्रम का पालन
option_b: Performance-oriented goals to mastery-oriented goals / प्रदर्शन-उन्मुख लक्ष्य के स्थान पर दक्षता-उन्मुख लक्ष्य बनाना
option_c: Teacher-centered pedagogy to exam-centered pedagogy / शिक्षक-केंद्रित शिक्षाशास्त्र के स्थान पर परीक्षा-केंद्रित शिक्षाशास्त्र को लागू करना
option_d: Formative evaluation to diagnostic evaluation / रचनात्मक आकलन के स्थान पर नैदानिक आकलन का पालन
explanation: Progressive education shifts from performance to mastery-oriented goals.

question: What is the role of peers in the socialization process? / सामाजीकरण की प्रक्रिया में समकक्षियों की क्या भूमिका है?
option_a: Peers have a minor influence on socialization compared to parents and other adults in all stages of development.
option_b: Peers are the primary agents of socialization for children.
option_c: Peers have a greater influence on socialization during adolescence than during early childhood.
option_d: Peers have no major influence on socialization.
explanation: Peers influence socialization more during adolescence than early childhood.

question: As per constructivist approaches of learning, learning is facilitated when: / सीखने के संरचनावादी उपागम के अनुसार, सीखना तब सुगम होता है जब:
option_a: Content is disconnected and eccentric. / विषय-वस्तु पृथक और उत्केन्द्री होता है।
option_b: Pedagogy is teacher-centric and culturally indifferent. / शिक्षाशास्त्र शिक्षक-केंद्रित और सांस्कृतिक रूप से पृथक होता है।
option_c: Tasks are incoherent and disorderly. / कार्य असंगत और अव्यवस्थित होते हैं।
option_d: Activities are interactive and collaborative. / गतिविधियाँ परस्पर संवादात्मक और सहयोगी होती हैं।
explanation: Constructivist learning is facilitated by interactive, collaborative activities.

question: Following Lev Vygotsky's ideas, a teacher decided to give hints and cues to the students who were stuck on a given problem and let the students try to solve that problem again. By doing so, teacher is practicing the concept of:
explanation: Giving hints within the ZPD exemplifies scaffolding.

question: According to Piaget when children reach the point of being able to generalize and engage in mental trial and error by thinking up hypothesis and testing them in their heads they are in:
option_b: Concrete operational stage / मूर्त संक्रियात्मक अवस्था
option_c: Formal operational stage / औपचारिक संक्रियात्मक अवस्था
explanation: Hypothesis testing in the head marks Piaget's formal operational stage.

question: How much longitudinal extent does one Time Zone of Earth of one Hour each cover? / एक-एक घंटे वाला पृथ्वी का एक समय-क्षेत्र कितना देशांतरीय विस्तार घेरता है?
explanation: Each one-hour time zone covers 15° of longitude (360/24).

question: A river makes waterfalls while flowing in the mountains. Select the two main reasons for the waterfalls. / पर्वतों में बहते समय नदी जलप्रपात बनाती है। जलप्रपात के दो मुख्य कारणों का चुनाव कीजिए।
option_a: River moves in between trees. / नदी पेड़ों के मध्य से बहती है।
option_b: River flows over very hard rocks. / नदी अत्यधिक कठोर शैलों के ऊपर से गुजरती है।
option_c: River moves over soft rocks. / नदी नरम शैलों के ऊपर से गुजरती है।
option_d: River flows down a steep valley. / नदी खड़ी ढाल वाली घाटी में गिरती है।
explanation: Waterfalls form when a river flows over hard rocks down a steep valley. (Key: a = b,d)

question: Consider the Assertion and Reasons: Assertion: There was a huge demand for Indigo in the European Market in 17th and 18th centuries. Reason 1: By the 17th Century, European cloth producers persuaded their governments to relax the ban on indigo import. Reason 2: By the end of the 17th Century, Britain began to industrialise.
option_b: Assertion and both the Reasons are correct
option_c: Assertion is wrong, Reasons on their own are right
explanation: Assertion and Reason 1 are correct; Reason 2 is not the main cause.

question: The first cotton mill in India was set up as a spinning mill in Bombay in the year: / भारत में पहली कपास मिल (स्पिनिंग मील) बॉम्बे में किस वर्ष स्थापित हुई थी?
explanation: India's first cotton spinning mill was set up in Bombay in 1854.

question: Sufficient Rainfall on the earth surface is very important for following reasons: / निम्नलिखित कारणों से पृथ्वी के धरातल पर पर्याप्त वर्षा बहुत महत्त्वपूर्ण है:
option_a: Survival of plants and animals. / पौधों तथा जीव-जंतुओं के जीवित रहने के लिए।
option_b: Brings fresh water to the Earth's surface. / यह पृथ्वी के धरातल पर ताजा जल लाती है।
option_c: It brings droughts. / यह सूखा लाती है।
option_d: Most of the ground water comes from rainfall. / अधिकतर भौम जल, वर्षा से ही प्राप्त होता है।
explanation: Rainfall matters for plants, fresh water and groundwater. (Key: d = a,b,d)

question: The cultural unity and diversity of the present time could be applied to which of the following historical facts related to Hampi? / हम्पी से संबंधित ऐतिहासिक तथ्यों में से किसके लिए प्रयुक्त किया जा सकता है?
option_a: Hampi temples were the hub of cultural activities.
option_b: Devadasis performed before the deity, royalty, but NOT before the masses.
option_c: The Mahanavami festival, known today as Navaratri in the south, was one of the most important festivals celebrated at Hampi.
explanation: Hampi's temple hub and Mahanavami festival show cultural continuity. (Key: b = a,c)

question: In the following, how many have been matched incorrectly? Kol rebellion-1831-32; Santhal revolt-1855; Bastar rebellion-1920; Warli revolt-1939. / कितने गलत मिलान हैं?
option_a: Only two of the above / केवल दो गलत
option_b: Only three of the above / केवल तीन गलत
option_c: None of the above / उपरोक्त कोई नहीं
option_d: Only one of the above / केवल एक गलत
explanation: Bastar (1910) and Warli (1945) are mismatched; two are wrong.

question: Which of the following places in India is Known as 'Little Tibet'? / भारत में निम्नलिखित में से किस स्थान को 'छोटा तिब्बत' कहा जाता है?
explanation: Ladakh is known as 'Little Tibet' due to Buddhist cultural influence.

question: Why is the globe considered as true model of the Earth? Choose the most appropriate statement: / ग्लोब को पृथ्वी का वास्तविक प्रतिरूप क्यों माना जाता है?
option_a: Countries, continents and oceans are shown in correct size. / देशों, महाद्वीपों तथा महासागरों को उनके सही आकार में दिखाया जाता है।
option_b: It is spherical in shape. / यह गोलाकार आकृति का होता है।
option_c: It is ball like. / यह गेंद की तरह है।
option_d: It if fixed. / यह स्थिर है।
explanation: Globe is a true model as it is spherical and shows correct sizes. (Key accepts a or b)

question: 'The farmer in USA works like a businessman'. Justify the statement. Choose the correct reasons: / 'संयुक्त राज्य अमेरिका में किसान एक व्यवसायी की तरह काम करता है'। कथन को उचित सिद्ध कीजिए।
option_a: Use of Tractors, harvesters / ट्रैक्टरों, हार्वेस्टर का उपयोग
option_b: Farm size is small / फार्म का छोटा आकार
option_c: Automated Grain storage / स्वचालित अन्न भंडार
option_d: Use of chemical fertilizers / रासायनिक उर्वरकों का उपयोग
explanation: US farming is mechanized and commercial. (Key: c = a,c,d)

question: What will be the time at 90° East when it is 12.00 noon at Greenwich Meridian? / जब ग्रीनविच याम्योत्तर पर दोपहर के 12:00 बजे हों तब 90° पूर्व में क्या समय होगा?
explanation: 90°E is 6 hours ahead of Greenwich, so 6:00 PM at noon GMT.

question: Analyze the following historical claims with reference to the relation between Tribes, Nomads and settled communities. Choose the appropriate option. / जनजातियों, खानाबदोशों और बसे हुए समुदायों के संदर्भ में विश्लेषण कीजिए।
option_a: Varna base society did not interact with the tribal people at all.
option_b: There were tribes that rejected both the caste system and orthodox Hinduism.
option_c: Some tribes established extensive states with well organized systems of administration.
option_d: Political power brought them in conflict with larger Kingdoms.
explanation: Claim (a) is false; b, c, d are valid. (Key: a = b,c,d valid)

question: In which year did James Mill publish his three volumes book titled 'A History of British India'? / जेम्स मिल ने अपनी तीन खंडों वाली पुस्तक कब प्रकाशित की थी?
explanation: James Mill published 'A History of British India' in 1817.

question: Match the following pairs: Coffee, Jute, Tea, Wheat with climate types. / निम्नलिखित युगलों का मिलान कीजिए।
explanation: Coffee-warm wet, Jute-high temp heavy rain, Tea-cool, Wheat-moderate.

question: 'The progress of any nation is dependent upon the unity of different social and political groups.' Which of the following major development/s in the national movement attest the above assertion? / राष्ट्रीय आंदोलन में कौन सी प्रगति उपरोक्त अभिकथन पर मुहर लगाती है?
option_a: During the Rowlatt Satyagraha, participants tried to ensure Hindus and Muslims were united against British rule.
option_b: From the late 1930s, the League began viewing the Muslims as a separate 'nation' from the Hindus.
option_c: The congress's rejection of the League's desire to form a joint Congress-League government in United Provinces in 1937/1938.
explanation: Rowlatt Satyagraha unity attests the assertion. (Key: d = A and B)

question: Which means of communication has the most important role in making world a large global society? / विश्व को एक बृहद विश्व समाज बनाने में संचार के किस माध्यम की अति महत्त्वपूर्ण भूमिका है?
option_a: Messages through Pigeons / कबूतरों के माध्यम से संदेश
explanation: Mass media plays the key role in creating a global society.

question: In reference to Panchayati Raj, which of the following sequence is in correct hierarchical order? / पंचायती राज के संदर्भ में कौन सा क्रम सही सोपानिक क्रम है?
option_a: Gram Sabha - Panchayat Samiti - Gram Panchayat - Zila Parishad
option_b: Gram Panchayat - Panchayat Samiti - Gram Sabha - Zila Parishad
option_c: Gram Sabha - Gram Panchayat - Panchayat Samiti - Zila Parishad
option_d: Panchayat Samiti - Gram Panchayat - Gram Sabha - Zila Parishad
explanation: Correct order: Gram Sabha, Gram Panchayat, Panchayat Samiti, Zila Parishad.

question: Tamil Epic Manimekalai was composed by: / तमिल महाकाव्य मणिमेकलै की रचना किसने की थी?
explanation: The Tamil epic Manimekalai was composed by Sattanar.

question: Which of the following is not an example of discrimination? / निम्नलिखित में से कौन विभेदीकरण का एक उदाहरण नहीं है?
option_a: Not allowing a group of people to drink tea in same cups as others.
option_b: Stopping someone from living in certain neighbourhood.
option_c: Asking a boy not to cry as boys don't cry.
option_d: Preventing a group of people from taking water from a common well.
explanation: 'Boys don't cry' is a stereotype, not discrimination.

question: The satnami movement in Central India was founded by: / मध्य भारत में सतनामी आंदोलन की स्थापना किसके द्वारा की गई थी?
option_a: Shri Narayan Guru / श्री नारायण गुरू
explanation: Guru Ghasidas founded the Satnami movement in Central India.

question: Celestial bodies in our solar system having their own heat and light are: / हमारे सौरमंडल में वह खगोलीय पिंड जिनके पास अपनी ऊष्मा तथा प्रकाश है:
explanation: Stars have their own heat and light via nuclear fusion.

question: Biotic and Abiotic conditions existing on the earth form (Choose the appropriate category): / पृथ्वी पर पाई जाने वाली जीवीय एवं अजीवीय परिस्थितियाँ बनाती हैं:
option_b: Human Made Environment / मानव निर्मित पर्यावरण
explanation: Biotic and abiotic conditions together form the natural environment.

question: Water scarcity is caused by the following given factors: / निम्नलिखित कारकों द्वारा जल का अभाव होता है:
option_b: Variation in Rainfall / वर्षा में विविधता
option_c: Contamination of water / जल का संदूषण
explanation: Rainfall variation, contamination and overuse cause scarcity. (Key: d = b,c,d)

question: Which one of the following is NOT a permanent wind? / निम्नलिखित में से कौन एक स्थायी पवन नहीं है?
explanation: Monsoons are seasonal, not permanent winds.

question: Consider the following statements of Bengal temple-building and choose the appropriate option: / बंगाल मंदिर निर्माण के कथनों पर विचार कीजिए।
option_a: Temples were built to demonstrate piety. / मंदिर भक्ति प्रदर्शित करने के लिये निर्मित किए जाते थे।
option_b: Temples were built to demonstrate power. / मंदिर शक्ति प्रदर्शित करने के लिये निर्मित किए जाते थे।
option_c: Temples began to copy the double-roofed structure of thatched huts.
option_d: Temples began to copy the four-roofed structure of thatched huts.
explanation: Bengal temples showed piety, power and copied hut roof structures. (Key: c = b,c,d... actually all)

question: Assertion: 'The process of India becoming a nation was a long drawn one. Emergence of political consciousness and the resulting political associations take time. India did not one day wake up to independence in 1947'. Choose the appropriate evidence as reason.
option_a: The consciousness of British control over the resources of India began to be clearly stated by political association formed after 1850.
option_b: The political associations worked with the idea that the people should be sovereign.
option_c: Poona Sarvajanik Sabha, Madras Mahajan Sabha functioned in specific parts catering to specific region, community and class.
option_d: The Ilbert Bill controversy deepened the desire for an all India organization of educated Indians.
explanation: Regional early associations show gradual nation-building. (Key: c = a,b,d)

question: In the context of Masulipatnam, which had contacts with distant lands for trade, choose the appropriate options: / मसूलीपट्नम के संदर्भ में उपयुक्त विकल्पों का चयन कीजिए।
option_a: In the 17th Century, both Dutch and English East India Companies attempted to control Masulipatnam.
option_b: Dutch were people from distant lands of Denmark and spain.
option_c: The competition between trading groups such as the Golconda nobler, Persian merchants, Telugu Komati Chettis and European traders made the city prosperous.
option_d: Mir Jumla, the Mughal governor began to play off the Dutch and the English against each other.
explanation: Masulipatnam prospered through trade rivalry. (Key: c = a,c,d)

question: (A): Lithosphere is the solid crust or the hard top layer of the earth. (R): It is made up of rocks and minerals and covered by a thin layer of soil.
option_a: Both A and R are correct but R does not explain A.
option_b: A is true but R is false.
option_c: A is false but R is true.
option_d: Both A and R are correct and R explain A.
explanation: Lithosphere is the solid crust made of rocks, minerals, thin soil; R explains A.

question: Dispel the misconceptions to arrive at appropriate conclusions with regard to changes in the colonial agrarian policies. / औपनिवेशिक कृषि नीतियों में परिवर्तनों के संबंध में भ्रांतियों को दूर कीजिए।
option_a: As Diwan, the company became the chief administrator of the territory under its control.
option_b: After 1765, company had to think of administering the land and organizing its revenue resources.
option_c: Before 1765, the Company purchased goods in India by importing huge quantities of grain from Britain.
option_d: After 1765, the revenue collected in Bengal could finance the purchase of goods for export.
explanation: Company became Diwan and financed exports from Bengal revenue. (Key: d = a,b)

question: 'Rampurva Bull', a finely polished stone sculpture of Mauryan period has been found from: / मौर्य काल की 'रामपुरवा बैल' की मूर्ति कहाँ मिली?
explanation: The Rampurva Bull sculpture was found in Champaran, Bihar.

question: Which of the following will help in developing better teaching learning environment in Social Science classrooms? / सामाजिक विज्ञान की कक्षा में बेहतर पठन-पाठन परिवेश के निर्माण में क्या सहायक होगी?
option_a: Development of reference libraries. / संदर्भ पुस्तकालयों का निर्माण
option_b: Creation of flexible school timings. / लचीले स्कूल समय का निर्माण
option_c: Accessibility to disseminative technologies only. / केवल प्रसार तकनीक तक पहुँच
option_d: Development of study material in regional languages. / क्षेत्रीय भाषाओं में पठन सामग्री का निर्माण
explanation: Libraries, flexible timings and regional material help. (Key: c = a,b,d)

question: Statement I: It would be easy to promote equity and democracy through a classroom where teachers do not allow children to ask question. Statement II: It would be difficult to promote equity and democracy through a classroom where varying opinions are encouraged to be voiced and debated.
option_a: Both Statement I and Statement II are false.
option_b: Statement I is true but Statement II is false.
option_c: Statement I is false but Statement II is true.
option_d: Both Statement I and Statement II are true.
explanation: Both statements contradict democratic education; both are false.

question: Which of the following are examples of intervention in religion by state as laid out in the Indian Constitution? / राज्य द्वारा धर्म में हस्तक्षेप के उदाहरण कौन से हैं?
option_a: Abolition of untouchability / अस्पृश्यता का उन्मूलन
option_b: Prohibition of child labour / बाल मजदूरी पर प्रतिषेध
option_c: Ban on child marriage / बाल विवाह पर प्रतिबंध
option_d: Laying out Vishakha guidelines / विशाखा मार्गदर्शिका को तैयार करना
explanation: Untouchability abolition and child marriage ban intervene in religion. (Key: b = a,c)

question: It is important to share examples of 'plurality of people' in a community in the Social Science textbooks because: / समुदाय में 'लोगों के अनेकत्व' से जुड़े अनुभवों को साझा करना जरूरी है क्योंकि:
option_a: It ensures labeling of community. / यह समुदाय के ठप्पाकरण को सुनिश्चित करता है।
option_b: It facilitates in judging the community. / यह समुदाय के संबंध में निर्णय लेने में मदद करता है।
option_c: It facilitates in generating portrayals of local community. / यह स्थानीय समुदाय के चित्र निर्माण में मदद करता है।
option_d: It ensures oversimplification of community. / यह समुदाय के अतिसरलीकरण को सुनिश्चित करता है।
explanation: Sharing plurality helps generate rich portrayals of local community.

question: Which of the following methods may be used for improving the national standards of Social Science education to meet the challenges of global competition? / वैश्विक प्रतिस्पर्धा की चुनौतियों का सामना करने के लिए कौन सी पद्धति उपयोग की जा सकती है?
option_a: Identifying learning outcomes. / अधिगम परिणामों का निर्धारण करना।
option_b: Developing innovative and improved evaluation tools. / नवाचारी और बेहतर मूल्यांकन उपकरणों का विकास करना।
option_c: Designing centralized, standardized and singular courses. / केंद्रीकृत, मानकीकृत और एकल पाठ्यक्रम का निर्माण करना।
option_d: Developing audio-visual and multimedia based interactive study material. / श्रव्य-दृश्य और मल्टीमीडिया आधारित संवादात्मक अध्ययन सामग्री का निर्माण करना।
explanation: Outcomes, evaluation tools and multimedia help; centralization does not. (Key: c = a,b,d)

question: Which of the following are institutional sources of debts in rural India? / ग्रामीण भारत में ऋण के संस्थागत स्रोत निम्नलिखित में से कौन से हैं?
explanation: Cooperatives and government banks are institutional debt sources. (Key: a = b,c)

question: Statement I: Social (Studies) Science became part of the official curriculum in modern India only with the Basic Education programme of Gandhiji. Statement II: The Secondary Education Commission provided the official recognition to the subject Social (Studies) Science at an all India level.
option_a: Both Statement I and Statement II are false.
option_b: Statement I is true but statement II is false.
option_c: Statement I is false but statement II is true.
option_d: Both Statement I and Statement II are true.
explanation: Gandhiji's Basic Education and Secondary Education Commission both recognized the subject.

question: Which of the following is/are correct in the context of testing? / परीक्षण के संदर्भ में क्या सही है?
option_a: It is carried out on skills related to a particular subject.
option_b: It is usually done by posing a set of questions in a uniform manner.
option_c: It is an unsystematic procedure for measuring the students understanding.
explanation: Testing is subject-specific and uniform, not unsystematic. (Key: b = a,b)

question: Democracy or equity should be taught: / लोकतंत्र या समता को पढ़ाया जाना चाहिए:
option_a: Only by make these as part of classroom process.
option_b: By covering these as knowledge areas but not as part of classroom process.
option_c: By covering these as knowledge areas as well as part of classroom process.
option_d: Only by covering these as knowledge areas.
explanation: Democracy/equity taught as knowledge areas and classroom process.

question: Consider the following in-text question 'fill in the blank' given in the chapter on urban administration: In a Municipal Corporation, the elected members are called which of the following abilities/skills is being tested here? / किसी नगर निगम में निर्वाचित सदस्यों को — कहते हैं। यहाँ किन कौशलों का परीक्षण हो रहा है?
explanation: Recalling the term 'councillor' tests remembering.

question: As a teacher of Social Science, which of the following will you be careful about while discussing issues like gender discrimination and caste discrimination? / लैंगिक और जातिगत भेदभाव पर चर्चा करते समय किसका ध्यान रखेंगे?
option_a: Encouraging speaking up in the class. / कक्षा में बोलने के लिए प्रोत्साहित करना।
option_b: Making students learn to listen to the others. / विद्यार्थियों को दूसरों की बात सुनना सिखाना।
option_c: Non-acceptance of conflicts in the classroom. / कक्षा में संघर्षों की गैर-स्वीकृति।
option_d: Developing an atmosphere of trust in the classroom. / कक्षा में विश्वास का वातावरण विकसित करना।
explanation: Encourage speaking, listening and trust. (Key: c = a,b,d)

question: Which of the following purpose Indian constitution does not serve to? / निम्नलिखित में से कौन से उद्देश्य का भारतीय संविधान निर्वाह नहीं करता है?
option_a: Keep itself static so that the structures in the society remain unchanged.
option_b: Coordination among different communities to live together.
option_c: Give rights to the citizens against individuals and communities.
option_d: Delineate the ideals a country should uphold.
explanation: The Constitution is a living document, not meant to stay static.

question: Which of the following actions would not be helpful in addressing the marginalisation of certain community? / किसी समुदाय के हाशियाकरण को संबोधित करने में कौन सी कार्रवाई सहायक नहीं होगी?
option_c: Protecting cultural diversity / सांस्कृतिक विविधता का रक्षण
explanation: Forced mainstreaming erases identity and doesn't help marginalisation.

question: Statement I: In school, summative assessment has more visibility. Statement II: Summative assessment checks the learning outcomes at the end of a grade or units or a term.
option_a: Both the Statement I and Statement II are false.
option_b: Statement I is ture but Statement II is false.
option_c: Statement I is false but Statement II is true.
option_d: Both the Statement I and Statement II are true.
explanation: Summative assessment is more visible and checks end-of-term outcomes.

question: Statement I: Political Science suggests dynamism that engages with processes that produces structures of domination and their contestations by social forces. Statement II: Political Science imagines civil society as the sphere where more informed. receptive and responsible citizens could be produced.
option_a: Both Statement I and Statement II are false.
option_b: Statement I is true but Statement II is false.
option_c: Statement I is false but Statement II is true.
option_d: Both Statement I and Statement II are true.
explanation: Both statements about Political Science are true.

question: If you want to introduce your students about the difference between the Buddha statues made in Mathura (Mathura Style) and Takshashila (Gandhara style), the most appropriate method would be: / मथुरा और गांधार शैली की बुद्ध प्रतिमाओं में अंतर बताने की सर्वोत्तम विधि?
option_a: Taking a trip to the National Museum / राष्ट्रीय संग्रहालय की यात्रा करवाना
option_b: Showing a power Point presentation based on above mentioned styles / पॉवर पॉइंट प्रेजेंटेशन
option_c: Interview with an Architect / एक वास्तुकार के साथ साक्षात्कार
option_d: Discussion based on the picture given in the textbook / पाठ्यपुस्तक में दी गई तस्वीर पर आधारित चर्चा
explanation: Textbook-picture-based discussion best highlights style differences.

question: Statement I: Assessment is made continuously in educational settings. Statement II: Assessment is a process that involves doing a number of things at different times.
option_a: Both the Statement I and Statement II are false.
option_b: Statement I is true but Statement II is false.
option_c: Statements I is false but statement II is true.
option_d: Both the Statement I and Statement II are true.
explanation: Assessment is continuous and involves many things at different times.

question: Statement (A): The work done by the public works department of the government do not need the approval of the members of the legislative assembly. Statement (B): People elect the members of the legislative assembly as their representatives.
option_a: A is false, B is true.
option_b: Both A and B are true and B is the reason for A.
option_c: Both A and B are true, but B is not the reason for A.
option_d: A is true, B is false.
explanation: PWD needs no separate MLA approval each time; both statements true but A phrasing—key: a.

question: Assertion A: A test is a form of assessment. Reason R: It answers the question, either in comparison with others or in comparison with a domain of performance task.
option_a: Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A.
option_b: A is true but R is false.
option_c: A is false but R is true.
option_d: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A.
explanation: A test is assessment; R explains it via comparison of performance.

question: Which of the following provisions does not promote social justice? / निम्नलिखित में से कौन से प्रबंध सामाजिक न्याय को प्रोत्साहित नहीं करते?
option_a: Special police stations / विशेष पुलिस थाने
option_b: Equal pay for equal work / समान कार्य के लिए समान वेतन
option_c: Prohibition on human trafficking / मानव तस्करी पर प्रतिबंध
option_d: Special schemes for girls in government schools / सरकारी विद्यालयों में लड़कियों के लिए विशेष योजनाएँ
explanation: Special police stations relate to law/order, not directly social justice.

question: Assertion (A): Like other subjects, in Social Science also learners need to be actively engaged in order to construct their own knowledge. Reason (R): Active engagement refers to engagement of body and mind.
option_a: Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A.
option_b: A is true but R is false.
option_c: A is false but R is true.
option_d: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A.
explanation: Active engagement of body and mind lets learners construct knowledge.

question: Assertion (A): In India, studying Social science is associated more with girls than boys. Reason (R): This type of approach to social Sciences is indicative of a 'patriarchal and gender biased' society.
option_a: Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A.
option_b: A is true but R is false.
option_c: A is false but R is true.
option_d: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A.
explanation: Gendered subject association reflects patriarchal bias; R explains A.

question: Statement I: Fieldwork, project work and group activities should form the basis of teaching-learning in Social Sciences. Statement II: Projects having direct link with the local community may be encouraged to develop curiosity in Social Sciences teaching-learning.
option_a: Both the statement I and statement II are false.
option_b: Statement I is true but statement II is false.
option_c: Statement I is false but statement II is true.
option_d: Both the statement I and statement II are true.
explanation: Fieldwork and local-community projects both aid Social Science teaching.

question: An important element in the Social Science classroom is the acknowledgement of India's diversity. Which of the following traits should you develop and inculcate in students so that this diversity is truly appreciated?
option_a: Reciting slogans about unity / एकता के विषय में नारे लगाना
option_b: Being sensitive and respectful while talking about cultures which are different from one's own.
option_c: Constantly reflecting on one's prejudices which might arise from one's social location in society.
explanation: Sensitivity and reflecting on prejudices appreciate diversity. (Key: c = b,c)

question: Which of the following is true in context of representative democracy in India? / भारत में प्रतिनिधिक लोकतंत्र के संदर्भ में क्या सत्य है?
option_a: Direct participation of people / लोगों की सीधी सहभागिता
option_b: Indirect participation of the representatives / प्रतिनिधियों की अप्रत्यक्ष सहभागिता
option_d: People exercising franchise / लोगों द्वारा मताधिकार का प्रयोग
explanation: Representative democracy means citizens exercise franchise to elect representatives.

question: While teaching your class about the government's responsibility of providing healthcare, you decide to conduct a debate between two groups of students on whether the healthcare system in the country is functioning properly or not. Which of the following is not a desirable goal of organizing a classroom debate?
option_a: Training students to make use of supporting evidence for their claims.
option_b: Improving students' abilities to see an issue from different perspectives.
option_c: Teaching students to become competitive and win at any cost.
option_d: Enhancing student involvement and participation in class.
explanation: Winning at any cost is not a desirable goal of a classroom debate.

question: Which of the following statements on markets are true? / बाजारों पर कौन से कथन सत्य हैं?
option_a: In weekly markets, things are available in cheaper rates because the shop owners purchase directly from the producers.
option_b: Phone and internet shopping have caused losses to the neighbourhood shops.
option_c: The goods sold in permanent shops are often costly because the shop owners have to bear the expenditure of rent, electricity, government fees etc.
explanation: Weekly-market cheapness and permanent-shop costs are true. (Key: c = a,b,c)

question: Assertion (A): Conventional Social Science teaching emphasizes learning about societies and times without reference to the child's actual lived experiences. Reason (R): Converting sets of 'Social Science facts' into processes of social inquiry has been a major strength of the texts (Based on NCF-2005).
option_a: Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A.
option_b: A is true but R is false.
option_c: A is false but R is true.
option_d: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A.
explanation: Both true; converting facts into inquiry is an NCF-2005 strength.

question: Which of the following feature of the Indian Constitution does not allow the legislature and the executive to interfere in the work of the judiciary? / कौन सी विशिष्टता विधानमंडल और कार्यपालिका को न्यायपालिका के कार्य में हस्तक्षेप की अनुमति नहीं देती?
option_a: Right against exploitation / शोषण के विरुद्ध अधिकार
option_c: Separation of powers / शक्तियों का पृथक्करण
option_d: Right to freedom / स्वतंत्रता का अधिकार
explanation: Separation of powers keeps legislature/executive out of judiciary's work.

question: 'Boys are into sports whereas girls are into arts and crafts'. What does this statement reflect? / यह कथन क्या विचार प्रकट करता है?
explanation: Gendered activity claims reflect stereotypes, not real difference.

question: Which one of the following words is most similar in meaning to the word, 'splendid'?
explanation: 'Splendid' means magnificent, grand and impressive.

question: Which one of the following words is most opposite in meaning to the word, 'retrieve'?
explanation: 'Retrieve' means recover; its opposite is abandon.

question: Study the following statements: (A) The baby pelicans pick their food from their parents' pouches. (B) The fish are kept in the pouches and eaten when the pelican feel hungry.
explanation: Young pelicans feed from throats, not pouches; both statements wrong.

question: Identify the clause in the underlined part: 'When the fish collect in the shallows,' the pelicans simply scoop them up.
explanation: 'When the fish collect' is an adverb clause of time.

question: Pelicans webbed feet make them —.
explanation: Webbed feet make pelicans powerful swimmers.

question: Pelican beat their wings over water also to—
option_a: Push the fish towards the shallow water
explanation: Wing-beating drives fish toward shallow water.

question: How does the brown pelican catch the fish?
option_a: By storing the fish in their pouch.
option_c: By conrnering the fish into low waters.
option_d: By diving on the fish from above.
explanation: The brown pelican dives on fish from above to catch them.

question: Pelicans usually live—.
explanation: Pelicans usually live near water bodies for their fish food.

question: Identify the clause of the underlined part: Chemical pesticides, 'which damage the eggs of pelicans,' devastate the sea birds.
explanation: 'Which damage the eggs' describes a noun, so it's an adjective clause.

question: What does the poet mean by velvet grass?
explanation: 'Velvet grass' means grass as soft and smooth as velvet.

question: How will you find a rabbit?
option_d: When he is in his burrow
explanation: The still rabbit becomes visible when he hops.

question: Which suprises do the meadows not hold for us?
option_b: Hopping of a frog out of the brook
explanation: The poem doesn't mention a frog; that surprise is absent.

question: According to the poem, which of the following kind of house is NOT found in the meadows?
explanation: A stable is human-made and not a meadow house in the poem.

question: A butterfly unfolding its drinking straw's. Which figure of speech is used in the above line?
explanation: 'Drinking straw' is a metaphor for the butterfly's proboscis.

question: Study the following statements: (a) The rabbit is hiding in a burrow. (b) The buttercup is tempting a butterfly.
explanation: Rabbit is sitting still not hiding; buttercup tempting is correct.

question: Mrs. Usha Rani supports her learners to speak English by making them use language for day-to-day purposes and teaching formulaic usages. What does she attempt to develop in her learner?
explanation: Day-to-day functional language develops Basic Interpersonal Communication Skills.

question: A teacher of class VII reads out the short text of seven sentences. Then she asks her learners to listen to it carefully and recreate the text nearer to it, not exactly the same text. What is this strategy known as?
explanation: Recreating a heard text near-original is paragraph dictation (dictogloss).

question: A teacher collects a particular pattern of errors of learners of class VII and discusses them once a month to make her learners aware of their errors. She does not reveal who committed those errors. She also asks her learners to reflect on their errors. What is this practice known as?
explanation: Systematic study of error patterns is error analysis / providing feedback.

question: Select two appropriate readings to promote school-based assessment.
option_a: It helps in the promotion of autonomy among both learners and teachers.
option_b: It gives scope for the school to plan on their own.
option_c: It takes away the examination board's power.
option_d: It does not involve learner as an active participant in the planning.
explanation: SBA promotes autonomy and school planning. (Key: d = a,b)

question: Rahul, a learner of class VI while learning the new grammatival form is able to connect what he has already learned. Which of the following strategies comes from this?
explanation: Linking new grammar to prior knowledge is a cognitive strategy.

question: Which of the following is true in terms of the objectives of Learning Outcomes?
option_a: Promote competency-based learning rather than content focused learning.
option_b: Enable learners to master the language skills necessary to become creative users of language.
option_c: Master the content and be able to apply it later.
option_d: Enable learners to learn to use language for specific purposes.
explanation: Learning Outcomes promote competency and use for specific purposes. (Key: c = a,d)

question: Vani is reading an article in order to get a general overview of the text. What is her reading known as?
explanation: Reading for a general overview is skimming.

question: What is the innateness hypothesis in language acquisition and language learning?
option_a: It believes that all human beings can learn languages through physical drilling and conditioning.
option_b: It believes that all human beings possess language knowledge at birth.
option_c: It believes that language is learned as a result of habit formation.
option_d: It rejects the idea that all language have grammars and all children learn them in their own way.
explanation: Innateness hypothesis: humans possess language knowledge at birth (Chomsky).

question: What does 'content-oriented language inputs' refer to?
option_a: Presentation of the inputs and its processes
option_b: Language inputs that focus on information
option_d: Language input, which focuses on how language is used
explanation: Content-oriented inputs focus on information and meaning over form.

question: Which of the following is NOT the aim of multilingualism in school education?
option_a: Learning of the mother tongue as a language and as medium of learning, as far as possible.
option_b: Learning of mother tongue, Hindi and English under three language formula.
option_c: All children begin their schooling with their mother tongue and move on the add many languages.
option_d: Making use of the languages of learners for teaching-learning in school.
explanation: The three-language formula is policy, not the direct aim of multilingualism.

question: Which of the following statements best describes 'procedural knowledge' in the context of learning grammar?
option_a: Knowing what a grammatical form is and using it.
option_b: Learning the rules of grammar and reproduce it later.
option_c: Understanding how a grammatical form works from a grammar book.
explanation: Procedural knowledge is knowing a form and using it in communication.

question: Which one of the following does not come under institutional writing?
explanation: Notes of condolence are personal, not institutional writing.

question: Words that we recognize when we hear or see them are known as:
explanation: Words recognized on hearing/seeing are receptive vocabulary.

question: Which approach to language teaching advocates words and word chunks as the foundation for language learning?
explanation: The lexical approach makes words and chunks the foundation of learning.

question: Which educational philosophy advocates the following? Learning environment such as real-world settings or case-based learning are used instead of predetermined sequences of instruction.
explanation: Real-world, case-based learning reflects constructivism.

question: अधोलिखितं कार्यं किं कथ्यते? एकः लघुपाठः द्वयोः पृथक् खण्डयोः निर्मितः। प्रत्येकं एकान्तरं वाक्यं एकस्मै युग्माय दत्तम्। प्रत्येकः छात्रः अन्यं छात्रं तं वाक्यं कथयति अन्यः च लिखति। इयं प्रक्रिया पुनः वैपरीत्येन क्रियते...
explanation: युग्मे परस्परं कथयित्वा लेखनं पारस्परिक-श्रुतलेखः (Mutual Dictation)।

question: उत्पादक-शब्दावलिः किम् अस्ति?

option_c: अस्माभिः श्रवणकाले कदाचित् पुनः स्मृताः शब्दाः
option_d: अस्माभिः लेखने सम्भाषणे च प्रयुक्ताः शब्दाः

explanation: विशिष्टसूचनान्वेषणार्थं पठनं क्रमवीक्षणम् (Scanning) कथ्यते।

version_note: Alternative language version (Sanskrit) of same slots 121-150
question: भाषाधिग्रहस्य भाषाधिगमस्य अन्तर्जातता-प्राक्कल्पना (Innateness Hypothesis) इत्यस्य विषये अधोलिखितेषु किं कथं सत्यम् अस्ति?
option_a: भाषा तेषां मानवानां कृते विशिष्टा भवति ये भाषासम्भाषणे समर्थाः भवन्ति।
option_b: छात्रेभ्यः प्रदतः भाषाध्यापकवर्गः, गम्भीर-अभ्यास-ड्रिलमाध्यमेन च भाषा-अवबोधे छात्रान् समर्थीकुर्वन्ति।
option_c: छात्राणां सहायक भाषा अध्यापकवर्गः छात्रेषु भाषाधिग्रहणाय, भाषोत्पादनाय च उत्तरदायी भवति।
option_d: इयं अभिभावकानां प्रयत्नानि, समकक्षिनः, बालकस्य समीपवर्तिनः च भवति, अपि च भाषाधिग्रहणाय महत्त्वपूर्णं वातावरणम् अस्ति।
explanation: अन्तर्जातता-प्राक्कल्पना: छात्राः जन्मसमये एव भाषाज्ञानं धारयन्ति (सहायक भाषा-अध्यापकवर्गः उत्तरदायी)। (आयोगेन c मान्यम्)

option_b: अव्यवस्थितं (Jumbled) शब्दानां वाक्येषु पुनरन्वयः यावत् एकः जनः शृणोति
option_c: कवितायाः सस्वर-पठनं (Recitation), तात्कालिक-भाषणं (Extempore speech), वाद-विवादः परिचर्चा च
option_d: श्रुतलेखः, क्लोज (Cloze) श्रवणं, बहुविकल्पात्मकप्रश्नानां प्रयोगः, सकारात्मक, नकारात्मकानां च कथनानां अभिज्ञानम्
explanation: श्रुतलेख व क्लोज श्रवणं ऊर्ध्वगामी (bottom-up) श्रवण-गतिविधिः अस्ति।

version_note: Alternative language version (Sanskrit) of same slots 121-150
question: विद्यालये सर्वे छात्राः स्वशिक्षां मातृभाषायां प्रारभन्ते। यदा ते विद्यालये अग्रेसराः भवन्ति, ते अन्याः भाषाः अपि शिक्षन्ते। शिक्षायां भाषानीतिविषये एतत् कथनं ज्ञायते-

question: काव्यस्य (Poetry) अध्ययन-अध्यापनाय अधोलिखितेषु किं कथनं न अनुमोदनीयम् (Endorse)?
explanation: काव्यं व्याकरणाध्यापनार्थं भवति इति कथनं न अनुमोदनीयम्।

version_note: Alternative language version (Sanskrit) of same slots 121-150
question: एका अध्यापिका अष्टमकक्षायाः छात्रेभ्यः अधोलिखितं कार्यं ददाति। अयं लेखनस्य कः प्रकारः कथिष्यते? युग्मेषु मस्तिष्कोद्बोलनं (Brainstorm) कृत्वा विचाराणां संक्षिप्तरूपेण लेखनं, तेषां च उत्तमलेखरूपेण विकसनम्। अत्र विषयस्य समर्थने द्वौ तर्कौ, विरोधे च द्वौ तर्कौ देये...
explanation: पक्ष-विपक्ष तर्कयुक्त लेखनं बहुविषयात्मक-लेखनम् (Discursive) अस्ति।

version_note: Alternative language version (Sanskrit) of same slots 121-150
question: अधोलिखिते कार्ये किं समाविष्टम्? छात्रेभ्यः एकस्य भोजनालयस्य व्यञ्जनसूची (Menu) प्रदत्ता। तैः चतुर्जनेभ्यः 1,800 रूप्यकेषु भोजन आदिष्टः (To order)। एकः जनः शाकाहारी अस्ति, अन्यश्च छात्राणां (Mushroom) प्रत्यूर्जिता (Allergy) अस्ति। तैः गृहं गन्तुं 70 रूप्यकाणि अपेक्षन्ते...
explanation: मेन्यू-आदेश कार्यं अध्ययन-युक्ति-परावर्तन-प्रयोगः (उच्चस्तरीय चिन्तन) अस्ति। (आयोगेन a मान्यम्)

question: भाषाध्यापने 'पदार्थानां/सामग्रीणां शिक्षाशास्त्रीय अवबोधः' इत्यस्य कः अभिप्रायः?
option_a: शिक्षाशास्त्रं अंगीकरणे अध्यापिकां समर्थीकर्तुं पदार्थेषु/सामग्रीषु शिक्षाशास्त्रस्य सन्निवेशनम्।
option_d: भाषा-शिक्षाशास्त्रस्य संवर्धनाय गतिविधीनां कार्याणां च सन्निवेशनम् (Embedding)।

question: अधिगमः एकः अर्थान्वेषणम् अस्ति। अतएव अधिगमस्य प्रारम्भः तैः विषयैः सह कर्तव्यः येषां विषये अर्थानां अधिगन्तुं ते सक्रियरूपेण प्रयतन्ते। अयं विचारः केन शिक्षादर्शनेन समर्थितः?
explanation: अधिगमं अर्थान्वेषणं मन्यमानः विचारः रचनात्मकतावादेन समर्थितः।

question: An effective strategy for solving ill-defined problems is: / अपरिभाषित समस्याओं को हल करने के लिए एक प्रभावी रणनीति है:
option_a: Focusing on functional fixedness / कार्यात्मक स्थिरता पर ध्यान केंद्रित करना
explanation: Means-ends analysis is effective for ill-defined problems.

question: Which of the following set of qualities characterizes critical thinking? / निम्नलिखित में से गुणों का कौन-सा समूह समालोचनात्मक चिंतन की विशेषताओं को दर्शाता है? (i) Ability to question (ii) Ability to self-reflect (iii) Ability to test previously held assumptions (iv) Ability to think convergently
explanation: Critical thinking = questioning, self-reflection, testing assumptions.

question: Which statement about the role of heredity and environment in child development is correct? / बच्चे के विकास में आनुवंशिकता और वातावरण की भूमिका के संबंध में कौन-सा कथन सही है?
option_a: Heredity contributes but development is solely environmental / आनुवंशिकता योगदान देती है, लेकिन विकास केवल वातावरणीय है
option_b: Heredity provides the genetic blueprint; gene expression can be influenced by environment / आनुवंशिकता वंशानुगत खाका देती है, जीन अभिव्यक्ति वातावरण से प्रभावित हो सकती है
option_c: Both contribute 50% each / दोनों का 50%-50% योगदान होता है
option_d: Dispositions linked with environment but development on heredity / स्वभाव वातावरणीय, पर विकास आनुवंशिकता आधारित
explanation: Heredity gives blueprint; environment influences gene expression.

question: Arpita and Anu give their books to each other since both consider it 'an equal exchange of favours'. At which level of Kohlberg's moral development theory are they? / अर्पिता और अनु कोहलबर्ग के नैतिक विकास सिद्धांत के किस स्तर पर हैं?
explanation: Equal exchange of favours = pre-conventional level.

question: Assertion (A): When unable to 'make meaning', efficient readers slow down and reread the text clarifying confusion before continuing. Reason (R): Metacognition hinders the process of meaning-making. / अभिकथन-कारण प्रश्न
option_a: (A) is true, but (R) is false / (A) सही, (R) गलत
option_b: Both (A) and (R) are false / दोनों गलत
option_c: Both true and (R) is correct explanation / दोनों सही, (R) सही व्याख्या
option_d: Both true but (R) not correct explanation / दोनों सही, (R) सही व्याख्या नहीं
explanation: A true; metacognition aids, not hinders, so R false.

question: Which of the following sets describe ways in which a school should be inclusive? / कौन-सा समूह उन तरीकों का वर्णन करता है जिनमें एक स्कूल को समावेशी होना चाहिए? (i) Modification of curriculum (ii) Expecting students to totally adapt to school's culture (iii) Fostering an ethos of care and respect (iv) Opportunities for collaborative learning
explanation: Inclusion: curriculum modification, care ethos, collaborative learning.

question: Which statement about socialization is correct? / समाजीकरण के बारे में कौन-सा कथन सही है?
option_a: Socialization cultivates shared sources of meaning and value / समाजीकरण अर्थ और मूल्य के साझा स्रोतों का निर्माण करता है
option_b: Socialization is culture-independent and context-neutral / सांस्कृतिक रूप से स्वतंत्र और संदर्भ-तटस्थ
option_c: Socialization happens only during childhood / केवल बाल्यावस्था में
option_d: Norms and beliefs cannot be acquired through socialization / मानदंड धारणाएं निर्मित नहीं की जा सकतीं
explanation: Socialization builds shared meanings and values.

question: Role of a teacher in 'reciprocal teaching' is characterized by: / 'पारस्परिक शिक्षण' में एक शिक्षक की भूमिका की विशेषता है:
option_a: A shift from support/guide towards gradual release of responsibility to students / मार्गदर्शक भूमिका से धीरे-धीरे जिम्मेदारी विद्यार्थियों को सौंपना
option_b: Being a recipient of suggestions given by students / विद्यार्थियों के सुझावों का प्राप्तकर्ता होना
option_c: Position of dominance and sole authority to disseminate information / एकमात्र अधिकारी और प्रमुख बनना
option_d: Being a passive observer throughout / निष्क्रिय पर्यवेक्षक होना
explanation: Reciprocal teaching: gradual release of responsibility to students.

question: An assessment approach aiming to support students' learning is characterized by: / विद्यार्थियों के सीखने का समर्थन करने वाली आकलन प्रक्रिया की विशेषता है:
option_a: Consideration of method of solving the problem along with the outcome / परिणामों के साथ-साथ समस्या हल करने की विधि पर ध्यान
option_b: Focus on inaccuracies only, ignoring process / केवल अशुद्धियों पर ध्यान
option_c: Exams at year end via objective questions / वर्ष के अंत में वस्तुनिष्ठ परीक्षा
option_d: Evaluation based on standardized quiz tests / मानकीकृत प्रश्नोत्तरी परीक्षण आधारित
explanation: Supportive assessment considers process alongside outcome.

question: Which of the following is an effective strategy of emotional regulation? / भावनात्मक नियमन की एक प्रभावी युक्ति कौन-सी है?
option_a: Channelling emotions to use them as a source of inspiration and creative endeavours / भावनाओं को प्रेरणा और रचनात्मक प्रयास के स्रोत रूप में उपयोग
option_b: Waiting until emotions escalate to losing control / नियंत्रण खोने तक इंतजार
option_c: Reacting impulsively to emotional triggers / आवेगपूर्ण प्रतिक्रिया
option_d: Suppressing emotions to conform to social norms / भावनाओं को दबाना
explanation: Channelling emotions creatively is effective regulation.

question: Learning about a concept/category is easier if: / किसी अवधारणा/श्रेणी के बारे में सीखना आसान है यदि:
option_a: Previous knowledge about the concept is not activated / पिछला ज्ञान सक्रिय नहीं है
option_b: Concept is represented in abstract and complex ways / अमूर्त व जटिल तरीकों से प्रस्तुत
option_c: Familiar examples are provided while introducing the concept / परिचित उदाहरण दिए गए हैं
option_d: Lots of advanced information is given to create cognitive load / संज्ञानात्मक भार बनाने हेतु उन्नत जानकारी
explanation: Familiar examples make concept learning easier.

question: According to Jean Piaget, what is the role of symbolic thought in cognitive development? / जीन पियाजे के अनुसार संज्ञानात्मक विकास में सांकेतिक चिंतन की भूमिका?
option_a: Develops after cognitive development is complete / संज्ञानात्मक विकास पूर्ण होने के बाद विकसित
option_b: Impacts development only in children with language delays / केवल भाषा विलंब वाले बच्चों में
option_c: Causes mental confusion and hinders development / भ्रम पैदा कर बाधा डालता है
option_d: Facilitates cognitive development by allowing mental processes like problem-solving / समस्या-समाधान जैसी प्रक्रियाओं से विकास सुगम बनाता है
explanation: Symbolic thought facilitates cognitive development via mental processes.

question: Which typical characteristics is a child struggling with dysgraphia likely to show? / लेखन-वैकल्य से जूझ रहे बच्चे में कौन-सी विशेषताएं दिखने की संभावना है?
option_a: Aggression, frustration and stress / आक्रामकता, हताशा और तनाव
option_b: Impulsiveness; difficulty concentrating and forgetfulness / आवेगशीलता, ध्यान केंद्रित करने में कठिनाई
option_c: Slow in written work; poorly formed letters, difficulty copying from blackboard / धीमी लेखन गति, खराब अक्षर, नकल में कठिनाई
option_d: Withdrawal, guilt and anxiety / प्रत्याहार, अपराधबोध और चिंता
explanation: Dysgraphia: slow writing, poor letters, copying difficulty.

question: A teacher provides learners chances to be exposed to and analyze concepts to understand content through her support. This is an example of: / यह किसका उदाहरण है?
explanation: Teacher-supported analysis of concepts is guided discovery.

question: Which statement is correct about gender development in contemporary times? / समकालीन समय में जेंडर विकास के बारे में कौन-सा कथन सही है?
option_a: Gender is purely and solely determined by anatomy at birth / जन्म की शारीरिक रचना से पूर्ण रूप से निर्धारित
option_b: Gender exists on a binary concept - male or female / जेंडर द्विवर्ग है
option_c: Gender identity is influenced by cultural conceptions / जेंडर पहचान सांस्कृतिक अवधारणाओं से प्रभावित
option_d: Gender identity is not influenced by socialization / समाजीकरण से प्रभावित नहीं
explanation: Gender identity is influenced by cultural conceptions.

question: Which of the following hinders problem-solving? / निम्नलिखित में कौन-सी प्रक्रिया समस्या-समाधान में बाधा डालती है?
option_a: Breaking down large complex problems into manageable smaller ones / बड़ी जटिल समस्या को छोटी में विभाजित
option_b: Fixating on a single trait of a composite problem / एक पहलू पर स्थिर होना
option_c: Applying algorithms and heuristics / कलन-विधि व स्वानुभविक प्रणाली
option_d: Using a solution effective in solving a similar problem earlier / पहले प्रभावी रहे समाधान का उपयोग
explanation: Fixating on a single trait hinders problem-solving.

question: Activities which ______ are detrimental to students' motivation to learn. / गतिविधियां जो ______, विद्यार्थियों की अभिप्रेरणा के लिए हानिकारक हैं।
option_a: Are moderately difficult for students / मध्यम स्तर पर कठिन
option_b: Connect with real life of students / वास्तविक जीवन से जुड़ी
option_c: Cater to students' needs and interests / जरूरतों और रुचियों को पूरा करती
option_d: Aim at intangible goals decided solely by the teacher / केवल शिक्षक द्वारा तय अमूर्त लक्ष्यों पर आधारित
explanation: Teacher-set intangible goals harm motivation.

question: Following Lev Vygotsky's ideas on learning, a teacher should: / लेव वायगोत्स्की के विचारों का अनुसरण करते हुए शिक्षक को चाहिए कि वह:
option_a: Encourage students to continually compete with each other / लगातार प्रतिस्पर्धा के लिए प्रोत्साहित करे
option_b: Prevent integration of cultural knowledge in discussions / सांस्कृतिक ज्ञान के एकीकरण को रोके
option_c: Capitalize on dialogue and group learning during activities / संवाद और सामूहिक शिक्षा को बढ़ावा दे
option_d: Discourage verbalization and thinking aloud / मौखिक अभिव्यक्ति को हतोत्साहित करे
explanation: Vygotsky: capitalize on dialogue and group learning.

question: Jean Piaget gave importance to ______ in the course of development and learning. / जीन पियाजे ने विकास और सीखने के क्रम में ______ को महत्त्व दिया।
option_c: Children's maturation and readiness to learn / बच्चों की परिपक्वता व तत्परता
explanation: Piaget emphasized children's maturation and readiness.

question: Assertion (A): Teachers should ensure enough 'wait time' after asking a question. Reason (R): Diversity is an asset and not an obstacle. / अभिकथन-कारण प्रश्न
option_a: Both (A) and (R) are true and (R) is correct explanation / दोनों सही, (R) सही व्याख्या
option_b: Both (A) and (R) are false / दोनों गलत
option_c: (A) is true, but (R) is false / (A) सही, (R) गलत
option_d: Both true but (R) not correct explanation / दोनों सही, (R) सही व्याख्या नहीं
explanation: Both true but R (diversity) doesn't explain wait-time A.

question: Assertion (A): Children learn most effectively when criticized frequently for their mistakes. Reason (R): Frequent criticism makes children self-reliant which improves academic performance. / अभिकथन-कारण प्रश्न
option_a: Both true and (R) is correct explanation / दोनों सही, (R) सही व्याख्या
option_b: Both (A) and (R) are false / दोनों गलत
option_c: (A) is true, but (R) is false / (A) सही, (R) गलत
option_d: Both true but (R) not correct explanation / दोनों सही, (R) व्याख्या नहीं
explanation: Frequent criticism harms; both A and R are false.

question: Inclusion of students belonging to disadvantaged backgrounds requires: / वंचित पृष्ठभूमि से संबंधित विद्यार्थियों को शामिल करने के लिए आवश्यक है कि:
option_a: Identity-based segregation of students / पहचान के आधार पर अलग करना
option_b: Consideration of socio-cultural diversity / सामाजिक-सांस्कृतिक विविधता का ध्यान
option_c: Execution of standardized curriculum / मानकीकृत पाठ्यक्रम का निष्पादन
option_d: Tradition of exam-centered pedagogy / परीक्षा-केंद्रित शिक्षाशास्त्र की परंपरा
explanation: Inclusion requires consideration of socio-cultural diversity.

question: Contemporary theorists believe that childhood is: / समकालीन सिद्धांतकारों का मानना है कि बचपन:
option_a: A life stage that is awaiting adulthood / वयस्कता की प्रतीक्षा करता चरण
option_b: A stage associated with divinity, purity and goodness / देवत्व, पवित्रता से जुड़ी अवस्था
option_c: Merely a transitional stage / केवल संक्रमणकालीन चरण
option_d: Variable and dynamic / चर और गतिशील
explanation: Contemporary theorists see childhood as variable and dynamic.

question: Assertion (A): A middle school language arts teacher selects stories/clippings portraying men and women in non-traditional roles. Reason (R): Countering prevalent gender stereotypes by presenting other models is an effective way to overcome gender bias. / अभिकथन-कारण प्रश्न
option_a: Both true and (R) is correct explanation / दोनों सही, (R) सही व्याख्या
option_b: (A) is true, but (R) is false / (A) सही, (R) गलत
option_c: Both true but (R) not correct explanation / दोनों सही, (R) व्याख्या नहीं
option_d: Both (A) and (R) are false / दोनों गलत
explanation: Both true; countering stereotypes explains the selection.

question: The process of bringing back the information stored in memory to current state is called ______. / स्मृति में संग्रहीत जानकारी को वर्तमान स्थिति में लाने की प्रक्रिया?
explanation: Retrieval brings stored information back to current state.

question: Which statement about classroom assessment is correct? / कक्षा आकलन के बारे में कौन-सा कथन सही है?
option_a: Use of norm-referenced assessment comparing peers motivates students / मानदंड-संदर्भित तुलना अधिक अभिप्रेरित करती है
option_b: Focus should be paper-pencil rather than non-written behaviours / पेपर-पेंसिल पर केंद्र
option_c: Formative assessment should include tasks informing teachers what students know before teaching / रचनात्मक आकलन में पूर्व-ज्ञान जानने वाले कार्य
option_d: Summative assessment serves no purpose / योगात्मक आकलन उद्देश्यहीन
explanation: Formative assessment reveals prior knowledge before teaching.

question: Assertion (A): Adaptations such as audio tapes, text-to-speech software, extended time facilitate learning for students who are visually challenged. Reason (R): Teachers should adapt the curriculum to provide equity and meet needs of diverse learners. / अभिकथन-कारण प्रश्न
option_a: Both true and (R) is correct explanation / दोनों सही, (R) सही व्याख्या
option_b: (A) is true, but (R) is false / (A) सही, (R) गलत
option_c: Both true but (R) not correct explanation / दोनों सही, (R) व्याख्या नहीं
option_d: Both (A) and (R) are false / दोनों गलत
explanation: Both true; curriculum adaptation for equity explains it.

question: Assertion (A): Adolescents have difficulty with emotional regulation and inhibiting impulses and are susceptible to peer pressure. Reason (R): Physiological and hormonal changes during adolescence impact behaviour in various ways. / अभिकथन-कारण प्रश्न
option_a: Both (A) and (R) are false / दोनों गलत
option_b: (A) is true, but (R) is false / (A) सही, (R) गलत
option_c: Both true and (R) is correct explanation / दोनों सही, (R) सही व्याख्या
option_d: Both true but (R) not correct explanation / दोनों सही, (R) व्याख्या नहीं
explanation: Both true; hormonal changes explain adolescent behaviour.

question: Gifted children: / प्रतिभाशाली बच्चे:
option_a: Excel in all academic as well as co-curricular areas / सभी क्षेत्रों में उत्कृष्ट
option_b: Exhibit high cognitive abilities as well as skills of social communication / उच्च संज्ञानात्मक व सामाजिक संप्रेषण कौशल
option_c: Get distracted easily and have low concentration span / आसानी से विचलित, कम एकाग्रता
option_d: Absorb information quickly and accurately / जानकारी को जल्दी व सटीक अवशोषित
explanation: Gifted children absorb information quickly and accurately.

question: Which statement about language and cognition is NOT correct as per Lev Vygotsky's theory? / लेव वायगोत्स्की के अनुसार भाषा और संज्ञान के बारे में कौन-सा कथन सही नहीं है?
option_a: Language development hinders cognitive development / भाषा विकास संज्ञानात्मक विकास में बाधा डालती है
option_b: Inner speech is used for mental reasoning / आंतरिक भाषण मानसिक तर्क के लिए
option_c: Language inevitably affects the way a child thinks / भाषा बच्चे के सोचने को प्रभावित करती है
option_d: External speech is used to converse with others / बाह्य भाषण दूसरों से बातचीत के लिए
explanation: False statement: language hinders cognition (it aids it).

question: Consider statements on the impact of Indigo crop on peasant life: A. When indigo delivered after harvest, a new loan given to ryot. B. Price peasants got was very low. C. Planters insisted on best soils for indigo. D. Indigo did not have deep roots and exhausted the soil. / नील की खेती के प्रभाव पर कथन
option_a: Only A, C and D are correct / केवल A, C और D सही
option_b: Only B, C and D are correct / केवल B, C और D सही
option_c: Only A, B and D are correct / केवल A, B और D सही
option_d: Only A, B and C are correct / केवल A, B और C सही
explanation: A, B, C correct; D wrong—indigo depleted soil differently.

question: Match the following columns: A. Creation of Andhra Pradesh as a State; B. States Reorganisation Commission submitted first report; C. Gujarat came into existence as a State; D. Haryana became a State. (i)1956 (ii)1953 (iii)1966 (iv)1960 / स्तंभों का मिलान
explanation: AP-1953, SRC-1956, Gujarat-1960, Haryana-1966.

question: The Buddha told the Vajjis they would continue to prosper as long as: A. They held frequent public assemblies. B. They met and acted together. C. They followed established rules. D. Vajji women were not held by force or captured. / बुद्ध ने वज्जियों से कहा
option_a: A and C are correct / A और C सही
option_b: A, B, C and D are correct / A, B, C और D सही
option_c: A, B and C are correct / A, B और C सही
option_d: A and B are correct / A और B सही
explanation: Buddha: all four conditions ensure Vajji prosperity.

question: Which is the correct sequence in which states were annexed under the Doctrine of Lapse, earliest to last? / विलय (लैप्स) नीति के अंतर्गत राज्यों के विलय का सही क्रम?
option_a: Satara, Sambalpur, Udaipur, Nagpur, Jhansi / सतारा, संबलपुर, उदयपुर, नागपुर, झांसी
option_b: Sambalpur, Satara, Nagpur, Udaipur, Jhansi / संबलपुर, सतारा, नागपुर, उदयपुर, झांसी
option_c: Sambalpur, Satara, Udaipur, Nagpur, Jhansi / संबलपुर, सतारा, उदयपुर, नागपुर, झांसी
option_d: Satara, Nagpur, Udaipur, Sambalpur, Jhansi / सतारा, नागपुर, उदयपुर, संबलपुर, झांसी
explanation: Satara(1848), Sambalpur(1849), Udaipur(1852), Nagpur(1854), Jhansi.

question: Which was a tax in the form of forced labour during the reign of the Cholas? / चोल वंश के शासनकाल में बलपूर्वक श्रम के रूप में लिया जाने वाला कर?
explanation: Vetti was forced-labour tax under the Cholas.

question: Read statements: (A) During 19th century, Christian missionaries began setting up schools for tribal groups and lower caste children. (B) At the same time, the poor began leaving villages to look for jobs opening in cities. / कथन A और B पढ़िए
option_a: Both (A) and (B) are true / दोनों सही
option_b: Both (A) and (B) are false / दोनों गलत
option_c: (A) is false, but (B) is true / (A) गलत, (B) सही
option_d: (A) is true, but (B) is false / (A) सही, (B) गलत
explanation: Both statements about 19th century are historically true.

question: Match crop/item with site: A. Green gram; B. Black gram; C. Fragmented animal bone; D. Dog. (i)Koldihwa (ii)Chirand (iii)Paiyampalli (iv)Burzahom / फसल/वस्तु का स्थल से मिलान
explanation: Green gram-Paiyampalli, Black gram-Koldihwa, bone-Chirand, dog-Burzahom.

question: The Paramhansa Mandali was founded in 1840 to work for the abolition of which of the following issues? / परमहंस मंडली का गठन 1840 में किसके उन्मूलन के लिए हुआ था?
explanation: Paramhansa Mandali aimed at abolishing the caste system.

question: The Ahoms migrated to the Brahmaputra Valley in the thirteenth century from present-day ______. / अहोम लोग तेरहवीं सदी में ब्रह्मपुत्र घाटी में वर्तमान ______ से आकर बस गए थे।
explanation: Ahoms migrated from present-day Myanmar in 13th century.

question: Match earliest kingdoms: A. Magadha; B. Vajji; C. Avanti; D. Gandhara. (i)Vaishali (ii)Rajgriha (iii)Taxila (iv)Ujjain / प्राचीन राज्यों का मिलान
explanation: Magadha-Rajgriha, Vajji-Vaishali, Avanti-Ujjain, Gandhara-Taxila.

question: From the following, how many pairs are correctly matched as mentioned in the Pallava inscriptions? I. Sabha–Assembly of Brahmin landowners. II. Ur–Organisation of Merchants. III. Nagaram–Village assembly. / पल्लव अभिलेखों में कितने युग्म सही सुमेलित हैं?
option_d: None of these / इनमें से कोई नहीं
explanation: Only Sabha–Brahmin assembly is correctly matched (one).

question: Who said, 'We must indeed become nawabs ourselves'? / किसने कहा था 'हमें वास्तव में खुद नवाब बनना होगा'?
explanation: Robert Clive said they must become nawabs themselves.

question: Which is NOT true for the Indian National Congress during the colonial period? / औपनिवेशिक काल में भारतीय राष्ट्रीय कांग्रेस के लिए कौन-सा सही नहीं है?
option_a: It demanded a greater voice for Indians in government / भारतीयों को अधिक जगह की मांग
option_b: It wanted Legislative Councils to be more representative / विधान परिषदों में अधिक प्रतिनिधित्व
option_c: It demanded civil service examinations be held in London, not India / परीक्षाएं लंदन में हों
option_d: In first twenty years it was 'moderate' / पहले बीस वर्षों में मध्यमार्गी
explanation: False: Congress wanted exams in India, not London.

question: Which statements are true about widow remarriage law in colonial India? A. A law permitting widow marriage was passed in 1858. B. Number of widows who remarried increased. C. Many conservative groups continued to oppose. D. Those who remarried were not easily accepted in society. / विधवा पुनर्विवाह कानून
option_a: A and D / A और D
option_b: B and D / B और D
option_c: C and D / C और D
option_d: A and C / A और C
explanation: Widow remarriage law opposed by conservatives; remarried not accepted.

question: Assertion (A): Tropical deciduous trees shed their leaves in the dry season. Reason (R): Trees adapt according to climatic conditions and shed leaves to conserve water in dry season. / अभिकथन-कारण प्रश्न
